      fun _ => by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]; exact hst⟩, fun _ => ⟨?_, Nat.zero_le _⟩⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, Cfg.mapState_output, hout]
  | d + 1, m, hm, S, c, hcs, hA, hA0, hB, hout => by
    have hk : m < N.k := by omega
    set t : Fin N.k := ⟨m, hk⟩ with ht
    set s := rs.flatMap List.ofFn with hs
    have hslen : s.length = (2 * N.k + 4) * rs.length := nf_stream_length N.k rs
    have he : nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) m =
        ⟨.rep (some t), (nf_leaf N (some t)).q₀⟩ := by
      unfold nf_tapeEntry
      rw [dif_pos hk]
    -- the replay of work tape `m`, from tape `1`'s head
    have hre := nf_retag (N := N) (SL := nf_LeafSt N) c (nf_Ph.rep (some t))
      (nf_leaf N (some t)).q₀ hcs
    set dL : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x :=
      { state := some (nf_leaf N (some t)).q₀, inputPos := c.inputPos, workTapes := c.workTapes,
        workTapePos := c.workTapePos, output := c.output } with hdL
    have hinit_state : (N.tm.initCfg x).state = some N.tm.q₀ := by
      rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state]
    have hinit_tape : (N.tm.initCfg x).workTapes t = fun _ => none := by
      funext p
      rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapes]
    have hinit_pos : (N.tm.initCfg x).workTapePos t = 0 := by
      rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
    have hblk0 : nf_blocks (dL.workTapes 1) (c.workTapePos 1) 0 (-1)
        ((N.tm.initCfg x).workTapes t) := by
      show nf_blocks (c.workTapes 1) _ _ _ _
      rw [hB, hinit_tape]
      refine ⟨fun y => ?_, fun y _ => rfl⟩
      rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T₁, hpre₁, hpass₁, hrej₁⟩ := nf_leaf_run_wk N t (c.workTapePos 1) rs dL
      (some N.tm.q₀, none, false) (N.tm.initCfg x) 0 (-1) hne hflag rfl hinit_state.symm hblk0
      (by show c.workTapePos 1 = _; rw [hinit_pos]; ring) (by omega) (by rw [hinit_pos]; omega)
      (by rw [hinit_pos]; omega) (by
        intro p hp
        show c.workTapes 0 (c.workTapePos 0 + p) = _
        rw [hA, hA0, zero_add, FinTM.bufferTape_nat])
    have hguard₁ : ∀ u < T₁, ∀ q, ((nf_M N (nf_leaf N) (nf_Ph.rep (some t))).runFrom dL u).state =
        some q → nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N) (nf_Ph.rep (some t)) q = none := by
      intro u hu q hq
      have h := hpre₁ u hu q hq
      show (match nf_leafExit N q with
        | some true => _ | some false => _ | none => none) = none
      rw [h]
    have hwin₁ : ∀ u ≤ T₁, ∀ b, ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom
        (c.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) m)) u).state ≠ some ⟨.park, b⟩ := by
      intro u hu b
      rw [he, hre]
      unfold nf_V
      rw [phaseHostTM_run_le (nf_M N (nf_leaf N)) _ (nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N))
        (nf_Ph.rep (some t)) dL T₁ hguard₁ u hu]
      exact nf_tagged_ne_park (fun h => nf_Ph.noConfusion h) _ b
    by_cases hok : ∀ r (h : r < rs.length),
        nf_ok N ((rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) rs[r] t.succ
    · obtain ⟨hT₁, B, lo', hi', y, hcfg, hsupp, hy1, hy2, hsz⟩ := hpass₁ hok
      set p₁ := c.workTapePos 1 with hp₁
      -- the replay passes: one dispatch to the return of tape `0`
      set c₁ : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x := { dL with
          state := some .pass
          workTapes := Function.update dL.workTapes 1 B
          workTapePos := Function.update (Function.update dL.workTapePos 0
            (dL.workTapePos 0 + ((2 * N.k + 4) * rs.length : ℕ))) 1 (p₁ + 2 * y + 1) } with hc₁
      obtain ⟨-, hR⟩ := phaseHostTM_run (nf_M N (nf_leaf N)) ⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩
        (nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)) (nf_Ph.rep (some t)) dL c₁ T₁ hcfg
        nf_LeafSt.pass rfl ⟨.aFwd (some t), .run⟩ rfl hguard₁
      have hre1 := nf_retag (N := N) (SL := nf_LeafSt N)
        (S := nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.rep (some t))) c₁ (nf_Ph.aFwd (some t)) SeekPhase.run
        (by rw [hc₁]; rfl)
      set c₁' : Cfg 2 Bool SeekPhase x :=
        { state := some .run, inputPos := c₁.inputPos, workTapes := c₁.workTapes,
          workTapePos := c₁.workTapePos, output := c₁.output } with hc₁'
      have hA1 : c₁'.workTapePos 0 = s.length := by
        simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL]
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), Function.update_self, hA0, zero_add, hslen]
      have htape1 : ∀ p, c₁'.workTapes 0 p = FinTM.bufferTape s p := by
        intro p
        simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL]
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hA]
      obtain ⟨c₃, h3, h3s, h3p0, h3p1, h3w, h3i, h3o, h3win⟩ := nf_aReturn N (nf_leaf N)
        (nf_leafExit N) (some t) s c₁' rfl hA1 htape1
      have h3' : (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom
          ((c₁' : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.aFwd (some t))) x).mapState
            (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.aFwd (some t)))) (s.length + 6) =
          c₃.mapState (fun _ => (⟨nf_Ph.bFwd t, SeekPhase.run⟩ :
            Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)) := h3
      have hre3 := nf_retag (N := N) (SL := nf_LeafSt N) (S := SeekPhase) c₃ (nf_Ph.bFwd t)
        SeekPhase.run h3s
      set c₃' : Cfg 2 Bool SeekPhase x :=
        { state := some .run, inputPos := c₃.inputPos, workTapes := c₃.workTapes,
          workTapePos := c₃.workTapePos, output := c₃.output } with hc₃'
      have hB3 : c₃'.workTapes 1 = B := by
        simp only [hc₃']
        rw [h3w]
        simp only [hc₁', hc₁]
        rw [Function.update_self]
      have hP3 : c₃'.workTapePos 1 = p₁ + 2 * y + 1 := by
        simp only [hc₃']
        rw [h3p1]
        simp only [hc₁', hc₁]
        rw [Function.update_self]
      -- the region of tape `1`, and its clear
      obtain ⟨R, i, hiR, hRlen, hieq, hRt, hclr⟩ := nf_region B (p₁ + 2 * lo') (p₁ + 2 * hi' + 1)
        (p₁ + 2 * y + 1) hsupp (by omega) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨c₅, h5, h5s, h5p1, h5p0, h5w0, h5i, h5o, h5w1, h5win⟩ := nf_bClear N (nf_leaf N)
        (nf_leafExit N) t R i hiR c₃' rfl (by
          intro p hp1 hp2
          rw [hB3, hP3]
          exact hRt p hp1 hp2)
      have h5' : (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom
          ((c₃' : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.bFwd t)) x).mapState
            (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.bFwd t)))
          ((R.length - i + 1 + 1) + (R.length + 3 + 1) + (2 * R.length + 2 + 1)) =
          c₅.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) (m + 1)) := h5
      have hc5A : c₅.workTapes 0 = FinTM.bufferTape s := by
        rw [h5w0]
        simp only [hc₃']
        rw [h3w]
        simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL]
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (by decide), hA]
      have hc5A0 : c₅.workTapePos 0 = 0 := by
        rw [h5p0]
        simp only [hc₃']
        exact h3p0
      have hc5B : c₅.workTapes 1 = fun _ => none := by
        funext q
        rw [h5w1 q, hB3, hP3]
        exact hclr q
      have hc5o : c₅.output = [] := by
        rw [h5o]
        simp only [hc₃']
        rw [h3o]
        simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL]
        exact hout
      obtain ⟨T₂, hv2, hf2, hacc2, hb2⟩ := nf_V_tail N rs hne hflag d (m + 1) (by omega) c₅ h5s
        hc5A hc5A0 hc5B hc5o
      -- the chain
      set TC := (R.length - i + 1 + 1) + (R.length + 3 + 1) + (2 * R.length + 2 + 1) with hTC
      have hrun1 : (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom
          (c.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) m)) (T₁ + 1) =
          (c₁' : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.aFwd (some t))) x).mapState
            (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.aFwd (some t))) := by
        rw [he, hre]
        unfold nf_V
        rw [hR, hre1]
      have hrun2 : (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom
          (c.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) m)) (T₁ + 1 + (s.length + 6)) =
          (c₃' : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.bFwd t)) x).mapState
            (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.bFwd t)) := by
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun1, h3', hre3]
      have hrun3 : (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom
          (c.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) m)) (T₁ + 1 + (s.length + 6) + TC) =
          c₅.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) (m + 1)) := by
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2, h5']
      have hall : (∀ (t' : Fin N.k), m ≤ t'.val → ∀ (r : ℕ) (h : r < rs.length),
            nf_ok N ((rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) rs[r] t'.succ) ↔
          (∀ (t' : Fin N.k), m + 1 ≤ t'.val → ∀ (r : ℕ) (h : r < rs.length),
            nf_ok N ((rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) rs[r] t'.succ) := by
        constructor
        · exact fun h t' ht' => h t' (by omega)
        · intro h t' ht'
          by_cases he' : t'.val = m
          · have : t' = t := Fin.ext he'
            subst this
            exact hok
          · exact h t' (by omega)
      refine ⟨T₁ + 1 + (s.length + 6) + TC + T₂, ?_, fun u hu b => ?_, ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun3]
        exact hv2
      · by_cases hu1 : u ≤ T₁
        · exact hwin₁ u hu1 b
        obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, u = (T₁ + 1) + v := ⟨u - (T₁ + 1), by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun1]
        by_cases hv1 : v < s.length + 6
        · exact h3win v hv1 b
        obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, v = (s.length + 6) + w := ⟨v - (s.length + 6), by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h3', hre3]
        by_cases hw1 : w < TC
        · exact h5win w hw1 b
        obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ : ∃ z, w = TC + z := ⟨w - TC, by omega⟩
        rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h5']
        exact hf2 z (by omega) b
      · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun3, hacc2]
        exact hall.symm
      · obtain ⟨ho, hT₂⟩ := hb2 (hall.mp h)
        refine ⟨by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun3]; exact ho, ?_⟩
        have hRle : R.length ≤ 2 * rs.length := by omega
        have e1 : (2 * N.k + 8) * rs.length = 2 * (N.k * rs.length) + 8 * rs.length := by ring
        have e2 : (2 * N.k + 4) * rs.length = 2 * (N.k * rs.length) + 4 * rs.length := by ring
        have e3 : (d + 1) * ((2 * (2 * N.k + 4) + 12) * rs.length + 15) =
            d * ((2 * (2 * N.k + 4) + 12) * rs.length + 15) +
              (4 * (N.k * rs.length) + 20 * rs.length + 15) := by ring
        rw [e3]
        rw [e1] at hT₁
        rw [e2] at hslen
        omega
    · -- a failed check rejects one dispatch after the replay's exit
      have hrj := hrej₁ hok
      obtain ⟨-, hR⟩ := phaseHostTM_run (nf_M N (nf_leaf N)) ⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩
        (nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)) (nf_Ph.rep (some t)) dL _ T₁ rfl
        nf_LeafSt.rej hrj ⟨.park, false⟩ rfl hguard₁
      have hver : ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom
          (c.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) m)) (T₁ + 1)).state =
            some ⟨.park, false⟩ := by
        rw [he, hre]
        unfold nf_V
        rw [hR, Cfg.mapState_state, hrj]
        rfl
      refine ⟨T₁ + 1, Or.inr hver, fun u hu b => hwin₁ u (by omega) b,
        ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => absurd (h t le_rfl) hok⟩, fun h => absurd (h t le_rfl) hok⟩
      rw [hver] at h
      exact absurd (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp (Option.some.inj h)).2 (by simp)

/-- Every check passes exactly when the control sweep passes, every input claim is checked, and
every work-tape claim is checked. -/
private theorem nf_allPass_iff (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (rs : List (Fin (2 * N.k + 4) → Bool)) :
    nf_allPass N x rs ↔
      nf_sweepPass N ((rs.flatMap List.ofFn).foldl (nf_sweepStep N) (nf_sweepInit N)) = true ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (h : r < rs.length),
        nf_ok N ((rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) rs[r] 0) ∧
      ∀ (t : Fin N.k), 0 ≤ t.val → ∀ (r : ℕ) (h : r < rs.length),
        nf_ok N ((rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) rs[r] t.succ := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, h⟩
    exact ⟨hc, h 0, fun t _ => h t.succ⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, h0, ht⟩
    exact ⟨hc, fun i => Fin.cases h0 (fun t => ht t (Nat.zero_le _)) i⟩

/-- **The verifier's characterization.** From the stream start of a stream of `n ≥ 1` records
(only the last end-flagged), the verifier reaches a first verdict, `acc` or `rej`, at some time
`TQ`. It accepts exactly when every check passes (`nf_allPass`); then its output is empty and
`TQ ≤ 4|s| + 10 + k((2(2k + 4) + 12)n + 15)`.

**Proof sketch.** The control sweep is the scan fold, `2|s| + 2` steps, and a failed sweep
rejects at the dispatch. Otherwise the input's replay runs from the stream start: a failed check
rejects at its dispatch, a pass is followed by the return of tape `0` to the first work tape's
entry, with tape `0` holding the stream, its head at `0`, tape `1` blank and the output empty.
The work tapes' part is `nf_V_tail` from there. -/
private theorem nf_V_char (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (rs : List (Fin (2 * N.k + 4) → Bool)) (hne : rs ≠ [])
    (hflag : ∀ r (h : r < rs.length), rs[r] ⟨2 * N.k + 3, by omega⟩ = decide (r + 1 = rs.length)) :
    ∃ TQ, (((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (rs.flatMap List.ofFn)) TQ).state = some ⟨.park, true⟩ ∨
        ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (rs.flatMap List.ofFn)) TQ).state = some ⟨.park, false⟩) ∧
      (∀ u < TQ, ∀ b, ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (rs.flatMap List.ofFn)) u).state ≠ some ⟨.park, b⟩) ∧
      (((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (rs.flatMap List.ofFn)) TQ).state = some ⟨.park, true⟩ ↔ nf_allPass N x rs) ∧
      (nf_allPass N x rs →
        ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (rs.flatMap List.ofFn)) TQ).output = [] ∧
        TQ ≤ 4 * (rs.flatMap List.ofFn).length + 10 +
          N.k * ((2 * (2 * N.k + 4) + 12) * rs.length + 15)) := by
  set s := rs.flatMap List.ofFn with hs
  have hslen : s.length = (2 * N.k + 4) * rs.length := nf_stream_length N.k rs
  set V := nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N) with hV
  rw [nf_tag]
  -- the control sweep
  obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := nf_sweep_run N x s
  have hguard0 : ∀ u < 2 * s.length + 2, ∀ q,
      ((nf_M N (nf_leaf N) nf_Ph.ctl).runFrom
        (streamStartCfg x 0 (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)) s) u).state = some q →
      nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N) nf_Ph.ctl q = none := by
    intro u hu q hq
    cases q with
    | done a => exact absurd hq (hs2 u hu a)
    | fwd a => rfl
    | bwd a => rfl
  obtain ⟨hp0, hD⟩ := phaseHostTM_run (nf_M N (nf_leaf N)) ⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩
    (nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)) nf_Ph.ctl _ _ (2 * s.length + 2) hs1
    (ScanPhase.done (s.foldl (nf_sweepStep N) (nf_sweepInit N))) (streamStartCfg_state _ _ _ _)
    _ rfl hguard0
  have hwin0 : ∀ u ≤ 2 * s.length + 2, ∀ b, (V.runFrom ((streamStartCfg x 0
      (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N) : nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s).mapState
        (Sigma.mk nf_Ph.ctl)) u).state ≠ some ⟨.park, b⟩ := by
    intro u hu b
    rw [hV]
    unfold nf_V
    rw [hp0 u hu]
    exact nf_tagged_ne_park (fun h => nf_Ph.noConfusion h) _ b
  by_cases hpass : nf_sweepPass N (s.foldl (nf_sweepStep N) (nf_sweepInit N)) = true
  swap
  · -- a failed control sweep rejects at the dispatch
    have hver : (V.runFrom ((streamStartCfg x 0
        (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N) : nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s).mapState
          (Sigma.mk nf_Ph.ctl)) (2 * s.length + 2 + 1)).state = some ⟨.park, false⟩ := by
      rw [hV]
      unfold nf_V
      rw [hD, Cfg.mapState_state, streamStartCfg_state]
      simp only [Option.map_some]
      rw [if_neg hpass]
    refine ⟨2 * s.length + 2 + 1, Or.inr hver, fun u hu b => hwin0 u (by omega) b,
      ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => absurd h.1 hpass⟩, fun h => absurd h.1 hpass⟩
    rw [hver] at h
    exact absurd (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp (Option.some.inj h)).2 (by simp)
  -- the input's replay
  set dS := streamStartCfg x (0 : Fin 2)
    (ScanPhase.done (s.foldl (nf_sweepStep N) (nf_sweepInit N)) :
      nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s with hdS
  have hre := nf_retag (N := N) (SL := nf_LeafSt N) (S := nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) dS
    (nf_Ph.rep none) (nf_leaf N none).q₀ (by rw [hdS, streamStartCfg_state]; rfl)
  set dL : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x :=
    { state := some (nf_leaf N none).q₀, inputPos := dS.inputPos, workTapes := dS.workTapes,
      workTapePos := dS.workTapePos, output := dS.output } with hdL
  have hinit_state : (N.tm.initCfg x).state = some N.tm.q₀ := by
    rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state]
  obtain ⟨T₁, hpre₁, hpass₁, hrej₁⟩ := nf_leaf_run_in N rs dL (some N.tm.q₀, none, false)
    (N.tm.initCfg x) hne hflag rfl hinit_state.symm
    (by
      show dS.inputPos = _
      rw [hdS, streamStartCfg_inputPos, NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos])
    (by
      intro p hp
      show dS.workTapes 0 (dS.workTapePos 0 + p) = _
      rw [hdS, streamStartCfg_workTapes, streamStartCfg_workTapePos, if_pos rfl, zero_add,
        FinTM.bufferTape_nat])
  have hguard₁ : ∀ u < T₁, ∀ q, ((nf_M N (nf_leaf N) (nf_Ph.rep none)).runFrom dL u).state =
      some q → nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N) (nf_Ph.rep none) q = none := by
    intro u hu q hq
    have h := hpre₁ u hu q hq
    show (match nf_leafExit N q with
      | some true => _ | some false => _ | none => none) = none
    rw [h]
  have hrun0 : V.runFrom ((streamStartCfg x 0
      (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N) : nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s).mapState
        (Sigma.mk nf_Ph.ctl)) (2 * s.length + 2 + 1) =
      dL.mapState (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.rep none)) := by
    rw [hV]
    unfold nf_V
    rw [hD]
    simp only [hpass, if_true]
    exact hre
  have hwin1 : ∀ u ≤ T₁, ∀ b, (V.runFrom (dL.mapState (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.rep none))) u).state ≠
      some ⟨.park, b⟩ := by
    intro u hu b
    rw [hV]
    unfold nf_V
    rw [phaseHostTM_run_le (nf_M N (nf_leaf N)) _ (nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N))
      (nf_Ph.rep none) dL T₁ hguard₁ u hu]
    exact nf_tagged_ne_park (fun h => nf_Ph.noConfusion h) _ b
  have hwin01 : ∀ u ≤ 2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + T₁, ∀ b, (V.runFrom ((streamStartCfg x 0
      (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N) : nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s).mapState
        (Sigma.mk nf_Ph.ctl)) u).state ≠ some ⟨.park, b⟩ := by
    intro u hu b
    by_cases hu0 : u ≤ 2 * s.length + 2
    · exact hwin0 u hu0 b
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, u = (2 * s.length + 2 + 1) + v := ⟨u - (2 * s.length + 2 + 1), by omega⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun0]
    exact hwin1 v (by omega) b
  by_cases hin : ∀ r (h : r < rs.length),
      nf_ok N ((rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) rs[r] 0
  swap
  · -- a failed input check rejects at the dispatch
    have hrj := hrej₁ hin
    obtain ⟨-, hR⟩ := phaseHostTM_run (nf_M N (nf_leaf N)) ⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩
      (nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)) (nf_Ph.rep none) dL _ T₁ rfl
      nf_LeafSt.rej hrj ⟨.park, false⟩ rfl hguard₁
    have hver : (V.runFrom ((streamStartCfg x 0
        (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N) : nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s).mapState
          (Sigma.mk nf_Ph.ctl)) (2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + (T₁ + 1))).state =
            some ⟨.park, false⟩ := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun0, hV]
      unfold nf_V
      rw [hR, Cfg.mapState_state, hrj]
      rfl
    have hnp : ¬ nf_allPass N x rs := fun h => hin ((nf_allPass_iff N x rs).mp h).2.1
    refine ⟨2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + (T₁ + 1), Or.inr hver, fun u hu b => hwin01 u (by omega) b,
      ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => absurd h hnp⟩, fun h => absurd h hnp⟩
    rw [hver] at h
    exact absurd (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp (Option.some.inj h)).2 (by simp)
  -- the input passes: the return of tape `0`, then the work tapes
  obtain ⟨hT₁, ip, hcfg⟩ := hpass₁ hin
  set c₁ : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_LeafSt N) x := { dL with
      state := some .pass
      inputPos := ip
      workTapePos := Function.update dL.workTapePos 0
        (dL.workTapePos 0 + ((2 * N.k + 4) * rs.length : ℕ)) } with hc₁
  obtain ⟨-, hR⟩ := phaseHostTM_run (nf_M N (nf_leaf N)) ⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩
    (nf_red N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)) (nf_Ph.rep none) dL c₁ T₁ hcfg
    nf_LeafSt.pass rfl ⟨.aFwd none, .run⟩ rfl hguard₁
  have hre1 := nf_retag (N := N) (SL := nf_LeafSt N)
    (S := nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.rep none)) c₁ (nf_Ph.aFwd none) SeekPhase.run
    (by rw [hc₁]; rfl)
  set c₁' : Cfg 2 Bool SeekPhase x :=
    { state := some .run, inputPos := c₁.inputPos, workTapes := c₁.workTapes,
      workTapePos := c₁.workTapePos, output := c₁.output } with hc₁'
  have hA1 : c₁'.workTapePos 0 = s.length := by
    simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL, hdS]
    rw [Function.update_self, streamStartCfg_workTapePos, zero_add, hslen]
  have htape1 : ∀ p, c₁'.workTapes 0 p = FinTM.bufferTape s p := by
    intro p
    simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL, hdS]
    rw [streamStartCfg_workTapes, if_pos rfl]
  obtain ⟨c₃, h3, h3s, h3p0, -, h3w, -, h3o, h3win⟩ := nf_aReturn N (nf_leaf N)
    (nf_leafExit N) none s c₁' rfl hA1 htape1
  have h3' : V.runFrom
      ((c₁' : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.aFwd none)) x).mapState
        (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.aFwd none))) (s.length + 6) =
      c₃.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) 0) := h3
  have hc3A : c₃.workTapes 0 = FinTM.bufferTape s := by
    rw [h3w]
    funext p
    exact htape1 p
  have hc3B : c₃.workTapes 1 = fun _ => none := by
    rw [h3w]
    funext p
    simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL, hdS]
    rw [streamStartCfg_workTapes, if_neg (by decide)]
  have hc3o : c₃.output = [] := by
    rw [h3o]
    simp only [hc₁', hc₁, hdL, hdS]
    rw [streamStartCfg_output]
  obtain ⟨T₂, hv2, hf2, hacc2, hb2⟩ := nf_V_tail N rs hne hflag N.k 0 (by omega) c₃ h3s
    hc3A h3p0 hc3B hc3o
  have hrun1 : V.runFrom ((streamStartCfg x 0
      (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N) : nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s).mapState
        (Sigma.mk nf_Ph.ctl)) (2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + (T₁ + 1)) =
      (c₁' : Cfg 2 Bool (nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) (nf_Ph.aFwd none)) x).mapState
        (Sigma.mk (nf_Ph.aFwd none)) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun0, hV]
    unfold nf_V
    rw [hR, hre1]
  have hrun2 : V.runFrom ((streamStartCfg x 0
      (ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N) : nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) nf_Ph.ctl) s).mapState
        (Sigma.mk nf_Ph.ctl)) (2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + (T₁ + 1) + (s.length + 6)) =
      c₃.mapState (fun _ => nf_tapeEntry N (nf_leaf N) 0) := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun1, h3']
  refine ⟨2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + (T₁ + 1) + (s.length + 6) + T₂, ?_, fun u hu b => ?_, ?_,
    fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]
    exact hv2
  · by_cases hu1 : u ≤ 2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + T₁
    · exact hwin01 u hu1 b
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ : ∃ v, u = (2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + (T₁ + 1)) + v :=
      ⟨u - (2 * s.length + 2 + 1 + (T₁ + 1)), by omega⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun1]
    by_cases hv1 : v < s.length + 6
    · exact h3win v hv1 b
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ : ∃ w, v = (s.length + 6) + w := ⟨v - (s.length + 6), by omega⟩
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h3']
    exact hf2 w (by omega) b
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2, hacc2, nf_allPass_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hpass, hin, h⟩, fun h => h.2.2⟩
  · obtain ⟨ho, hT₂⟩ := hb2 ((nf_allPass_iff N x rs).mp h).2.2
    refine ⟨by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, hrun2]; exact ho, ?_⟩
    rw [hT₁]
    have e2 : (2 * N.k + 4) * rs.length = s.length := hslen.symm
    rw [e2]
    omega

/-- **A stream that first stops the controller is a stream of records**: `n ≥ 1` records of width
`2k + 4`, only the last end-flagged.

**Proof sketch.** The first-stop criterion gives the length `(2k + 4)n` and the flags. Cut the
stream into `n` records of `2k + 4` cells by the product law of `List.ofFn`; the end flag of record
`r` is the stream's cell `(2k + 4)(r + 1) - 1`. -/
private theorem nf_split (k : ℕ) (s : List Bool)
    (hlive : ∀ i < s.length, nf_ctlStop k ((s.take i).foldl (nf_ctlStep k) (0, false)) = false)
    (hstop : nf_ctlStop k (s.foldl (nf_ctlStep k) (0, false)) = true) :
    ∃ rs : List (Fin (2 * k + 4) → Bool), rs ≠ [] ∧ s = rs.flatMap List.ofFn ∧
      ∀ r (h : r < rs.length), rs[r] ⟨2 * k + 3, by omega⟩ = decide (r + 1 = rs.length) := by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hlen, hfl⟩ := nf_firstStop_records k s hlive hstop
  have hidx : ∀ (r : Fin n) (p : Fin (2 * k + 4)), (2 * k + 4) * r.val + p.val < s.length := by
    intro r p
    rw [hlen]
    have h1 := p.isLt
    have h2 : (2 * k + 4) * (r.val + 1) ≤ (2 * k + 4) * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ r.isLt
    rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] at h2
    omega
  refine ⟨List.ofFn fun r : Fin n => fun p : Fin (2 * k + 4) =>
    s[(2 * k + 4) * r.val + p.val]'(hidx r p), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact mt List.ofFn_eq_nil_iff.mp hn.ne'
  · have h := List.ofFn_mul' (m := 2 * k + 4) (n := n)
      (fun i : Fin ((2 * k + 4) * n) => s[i.val]'(by rw [hlen]; exact i.isLt))
    have h0 : List.ofFn (fun i : Fin ((2 * k + 4) * n) => s[i.val]'(by rw [hlen]; exact i.isLt)) =
        s :=
      (List.ofFn_congr hlen (fun i : Fin s.length => s[i.val])).symm.trans (List.ofFn_getElem s)
    rw [List.flatMap_def, List.map_ofFn]
    exact h0.symm.trans h
  · intro r hr
    rw [List.length_ofFn] at hr ⊢
    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
    have hf := hfl r hr
    have e : (2 * k + 4) * (r + 1) - 1 = (2 * k + 4) * r + (2 * k + 3) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
      omega
    rw [e, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (hidx ⟨r, hr⟩ ⟨2 * k + 3, by omega⟩)] at hf
    exact Option.some.inj hf

/-- The trivial setup: one state, its own exit. -/
private def nf_P : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool Unit :=
  ⟨(), fun _ _ _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some ()⟩⟩

/-- **The backward lemma's obligation `hV`.** For every stream that first stops the controller at
its end, well formed or not in content, the verifier reaches a verdict, `acc` or `rej`, from the
host's entry configuration after the trivial setup, and is at neither before.

**Proof sketch.** The entry configuration is the stream start; the stream is a stream of records;
the characterization gives the first verdict. -/
private theorem nf_hV (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x s : List Bool)
    (hlive : ∀ i < s.length,
      nf_ctlStop N.k ((s.take i).foldl (nf_ctlStep N.k) (0, false)) = false)
    (hstop : nf_ctlStop N.k (s.foldl (nf_ctlStep N.k) (0, false)) = true) :
    ∃ TQ : ℕ,
      (((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (guessRunCfg (nf_P.initCfg x) 0 s
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)) TQ).state =
            some ⟨.park, true⟩ ∨
        ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (guessRunCfg (nf_P.initCfg x) 0 s
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)) TQ).state =
            some ⟨.park, false⟩) ∧
      ∀ u < TQ,
        ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (guessRunCfg (nf_P.initCfg x) 0 s
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)) u).state ≠
            some ⟨.park, true⟩ ∧
        ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (guessRunCfg (nf_P.initCfg x) 0 s
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)) u).state ≠
            some ⟨.park, false⟩ := by
  rw [nf_entry]
  obtain ⟨rs, hne, rfl, hflag⟩ := nf_split N.k s hlive hstop
  obtain ⟨TQ, hv, hf, -, -⟩ := nf_V_char N x rs hne hflag
  exact ⟨TQ, hv, fun u hu => ⟨hf u hu true, hf u hu false⟩⟩

/-- **Checked claims make the decoded virtual run genuine.** If every claim of every record before
the `r`th is checked along the decoded virtual run, then the run after `r` records is `N`'s run
under the records' first `r` choice bits.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `r`. A record whose claims are all checked decodes to the
configuration's reads at a live state, so the recomputed action is the table's action there under
the record's choice bit, and the virtual step is `N`'s step. -/
private theorem nf_vrun_of_ok (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (rs : List (Fin (2 * N.k + 4) → Bool)) :
    ∀ (r : ℕ) (_ : r ≤ rs.length), (∀ r' (h : r' < r) (i : Fin (N.k + 1)),
        nf_ok N ((rs.take r').foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) (rs[r']'(by omega)) i) →
      (rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x) =
        N.tm.runWith ((rs.map (fun r => r 0)).take r) (N.tm.initCfg x)
  | 0, _, _ => by rw [List.take_zero, List.foldl_nil, List.take_zero, NDTM.runWith_nil]
  | r + 1, hr, hok => by
    have hlt : r < rs.length := by omega
    have ih := nf_vrun_of_ok N x rs r (by omega) (fun r' h' i => hok r' (by omega) i)
    have hok' : ∀ i, nf_ok N (N.tm.runWith ((rs.map (fun r => r 0)).take r) (N.tm.initCfg x))
        rs[r] i := by
      intro i
      have := hok r (by omega) i
      rwa [ih] at this
    rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hlt, List.foldl_concat, ih,
      List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem (by rw [List.length_map]; exact hlt),
      NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_nil]
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp (hok' 0).1
    have hd0 : nf_decode N.k (fun p => some (rs[r] p)) 0 =
        (N.tm.runWith ((rs.map (fun r => r 0)).take r) (N.tm.initCfg x)).inputSymbol :=
      (hok' 0).2
    have hds : (fun j : Fin N.k => nf_decode N.k (fun p => some (rs[r] p)) j.succ) =
        (N.tm.runWith ((rs.map (fun r => r 0)).take r) (N.tm.initCfg x)).workTapeSymbols := by
      funext j
      exact (hok' j.succ).2
    simp only [nf_vstep, hq]
    rw [NDTM.stepWith_of_some hq]
    unfold nf_act
    rw [Option.getD_some, hd0, hds, List.getElem_map]

/-- **The verifier accepts a genuine display.** The display of a branch that is live before its
end, halts at its end and outputs exactly `[true]` passes every check; so the verifier's first
verdict on it is `acc`, with an empty output, within the characterization's bound.

**Proof sketch.** The display is a stream of genuine records, only the last end-flagged. The
control sweep passes it. By strong induction on records, the claims checked so far make the decoded
virtual run the genuine run, live before the end, whose reads the next record's claims are. -/
private theorem nf_V_display (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) (hw : w ≠ [])
    (hlive : ∀ r < w.length, (N.tm.runWith (w.take r) (N.tm.initCfg x)).state ≠ none)
    (hhalt : (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)).state = none)
    (hout : (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true]) :
    ∃ TQ, ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (nf_display N x w)) TQ).state = some ⟨.park, true⟩ ∧
      (∀ u < TQ, ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (nf_display N x w)) u).state ≠ some ⟨.park, true⟩ ∧
        ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (nf_display N x w)) u).state ≠ some ⟨.park, false⟩) ∧
      ((nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)).runFrom (streamStartCfg x 0
          (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)
          (nf_display N x w)) TQ).output = [] ∧
      TQ ≤ 4 * (nf_display N x w).length + 10 +
        N.k * ((2 * (2 * N.k + 4) + 12) * w.length + 15) := by
  obtain ⟨rs, hrs⟩ : ∃ rs, rs = List.ofFn fun r : Fin w.length =>
      let c := N.tm.runWith (w.take r.val) (N.tm.initCfg x)
      nf_record N.k w[r.val] (Fin.cases c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols)
        (decide (r.val + 1 = w.length)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hdisp : nf_display N x w = rs.flatMap List.ofFn := by
    rw [hrs]
    exact nf_display_records N x w
  have hrlen : rs.length = w.length := by rw [hrs, List.length_ofFn]
  have hget : ∀ r (h : r < rs.length), rs[r] =
      nf_record N.k (w[r]'(by rw [hrlen] at h; exact h))
        (Fin.cases (N.tm.runWith (w.take r) (N.tm.initCfg x)).inputSymbol
          (N.tm.runWith (w.take r) (N.tm.initCfg x)).workTapeSymbols)
        (decide (r + 1 = w.length)) := by
    subst hrs
    intro r h
    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
  have hne : rs ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos (hrlen ▸ List.length_pos_iff.mpr hw)
  have hflag : ∀ r (h : r < rs.length),
      rs[r] ⟨2 * N.k + 3, by omega⟩ = decide (r + 1 = rs.length) := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hget r hr]
    exact (nf_record_last N.k _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun n => decide (r + 1 = n)) hrlen.symm)
  have hmap : rs.map (fun r => r 0) = w := by
    apply List.ext_getElem (by rw [List.length_map, hrlen])
    intro r h1 h2
    rw [List.getElem_map, hget r (by rw [List.length_map] at h1; exact h1)]
    exact nf_record_choice N.k _ _ _
  have hok : ∀ r (hr : r < rs.length) (i : Fin (N.k + 1)),
      nf_ok N ((rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x)) rs[r] i := by
    intro r
    induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ r ih =>
      intro hr i
      rw [nf_vrun_of_ok N x rs r hr.le (fun r' h' i' => ih r' h' (by omega) i'), hmap]
      refine ⟨hlive r (by rw [← hrlen]; exact hr), ?_⟩
      rw [hget r hr]
      exact nf_decode_record N.k _ _ _ i
  have hall : nf_allPass N x rs := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun i r hr => hok r hr i⟩
    rw [← hdisp]
    exact nf_sweep_display_pass N x w hlive hhalt hout
  rw [hdisp]
  obtain ⟨TQ, -, hf, hacc, hb⟩ := nf_V_char N x rs hne hflag
  obtain ⟨ho, hT⟩ := hb hall
  refine ⟨TQ, hacc.mpr hall, fun u hu => ⟨hf u hu true, hf u hu false⟩, ho, ?_⟩
  rw [hrlen] at hT
  exact hT

/-! ### The transfers -/

/-- The normal form's constant for `k` work tapes, with the record width `W = 2k + 4`:
`6W + k(2W + 12) + 21 + 15k`. -/
private def nf_C (k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  6 * (2 * k + 4) + k * (2 * (2 * k + 4) + 12) + 21 + 15 * k

/-- The normal form's machine: the controller-stopped host over the trivial setup, the display
controller, and the verifier, guessing on tape `0`. -/
private def nf_host (N : FinNDTM Bool) :=
  guessCtlRunTM nf_P nf_P.q₀ 0 ((0 : Fin (2 * N.k + 4)), false) (nf_ctlStep N.k) (nf_ctlStop N.k)
    false (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N))
    (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i) ⟨.park, true⟩
    ⟨.park, false⟩

/-- **The ledger.** With `|s| = (2k + 4)t₀` and the verifier's time at most
`4|s| + 10 + k((2(2k + 4) + 12)t₀ + 15)`, the host's budget `0 + 2|s| + TQ + 11` is at most
`nf_C k · (t + 1)` for every `t ≥ t₀`.

**Proof sketch.** Collect the budget as `(6(2k + 4) + k(2(2k + 4) + 12))t₀ + 21 + 15k`, raise `t₀`
to `t`, and bound the constant term by `(21 + 15k)(t + 1)`. -/
private theorem nf_ledger (k t₀ t s TQ : ℕ) (ht : t₀ ≤ t) (hs : s = (2 * k + 4) * t₀)
    (hT : TQ ≤ 4 * s + 10 + k * ((2 * (2 * k + 4) + 12) * t₀ + 15)) :
    0 + 2 * s + TQ + 11 ≤ nf_C k * (t + 1) := by
  set A := 6 * (2 * k + 4) + k * (2 * (2 * k + 4) + 12) with hA
  have e1 : 2 * s + (4 * s + 10 + k * ((2 * (2 * k + 4) + 12) * t₀ + 15)) + 11 =
      A * t₀ + (21 + 15 * k) := by
    rw [hs, hA]
    ring
  have h2 : A * t₀ ≤ A * t := Nat.mul_le_mul_left A ht
  have h3 : 21 + 15 * k ≤ (21 + 15 * k) * (t + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.succ_pos t)
  have e4 : nf_C k * (t + 1) = A * t + A + (21 + 15 * k) * (t + 1) := by
    unfold nf_C
    rw [hA]
    ring
  omega

/-- **The forward transfer.** If `N` accepts `x` within `t` steps, the normal form's machine accepts
`x` within exactly `nf_C N.k · (t + 1)` choices.

**Proof sketch.** Cut the accepting word at its first halting time `t₀ ≥ 1`, at most `t`; the
branch is live before `t₀`, halted at `t₀` and outputs `[true]` there, as at `t`. Its display first
stops the controller at its end, and the verifier accepts it at its first verdict, with an empty
output, within the characterization's bound. The host's forward acceptance lemma, after the
trivial setup, accepts at every budget past the ledger's. -/
private theorem nf_forward (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (hN : N.AcceptsWithin x t) :
    ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = nf_C N.k * (t + 1) ∧
      ((nf_host N).runWith w ((nf_host N).initCfg x)).state = none ∧
      ((nf_host N).runWith w ((nf_host N).initCfg x)).output = [true] := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hh, ho⟩ := FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mp hN
  -- the first halting time
  obtain ⟨t₀, hle, hspec, hmin, hfirst⟩ := N.tm.exists_first_halt (N.tm.initCfg x) hh
  rw [hw] at hle
  have hpos : 0 < t₀ := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h00 => NDTM.not_haltsWithin_zero N.tm x
      (NDTM.haltsWithin_iff.mpr fun v hv => ?_)
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hv]
    rwa [h00, List.take_zero] at hspec
  set w₀ := w.take t₀ with hw₀
  have hw₀len : w₀.length = t₀ := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
  have hw₀ne : w₀ ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos (by omega)
  have hlive : ∀ r < w₀.length, (N.tm.runWith (w₀.take r) (N.tm.initCfg x)).state ≠ none := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hw₀len] at hr
    rw [hw₀, List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left hr.le]
    exact hmin r hr
  have hout : (N.tm.runWith w₀ (N.tm.initCfg x)).output = [true] := by
    rw [hw₀, ← hfirst]
    exact ho
  -- the verifier on the branch's display
  obtain ⟨TQ, hacc, hfirst, hnil, hTQ⟩ := nf_V_display N x w₀ hw₀ne hlive hspec hout
  obtain ⟨hslive, hsstop⟩ := nf_display_firstStop N x w₀ hw₀ne
  obtain ⟨h0, hst, hfi, hbl, hlf⟩ := nf_setup nf_P x 0
  have hB : 0 + 2 * (nf_display N x w₀).length + TQ + 11 ≤ nf_C N.k * (t + 1) := by
    refine nf_ledger N.k t₀ t _ TQ hle (by rw [nf_display_length, hw₀len]) ?_
    rw [hw₀len] at hTQ
    exact hTQ
  rw [← nf_entry nf_P x (nf_display N x w₀)] at hacc hfirst hnil
  exact guessCtlRunTM_accepts_of nf_P nf_P.q₀ 0 ((0 : Fin (2 * N.k + 4)), false)
    (nf_ctlStep N.k) (nf_ctlStop N.k) (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N))
    ⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ ⟨.park, true⟩ ⟨.park, false⟩ 0 (nf_P.initCfg x)
    h0 hst hfi hbl hlf (nf_display N x w₀) hslive hsstop TQ hacc hfirst hnil _ hB

/-- **A passing stream of records is a genuine accepting run.** If every check passes on `n`
records, then `N` accepts `x` within `n` steps, with the records' choice bits as the word.

**Proof sketch.** Passed checks make the decoded virtual run `N`'s run under the choice bits.
The control fold follows the virtual run's state and output summary; the control sweep's pass then
says the run has halted with output summary `[true]`, so with output exactly `[true]`. Claims are
read through `nf_decode` throughout: a record whose presence bit is false reads as blank whatever
its value bit, so the code `01` is no loophole. -/
private theorem nf_backward (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (rs : List (Fin (2 * N.k + 4) → Bool)) (h : nf_allPass N x rs) :
    N.AcceptsWithin x rs.length := by
  obtain ⟨hctl, hok⟩ := h
  set w := rs.map (fun r => r 0) with hw
  have hwlen : w.length = rs.length := List.length_map _
  have hgen : ∀ r ≤ rs.length, (rs.take r).foldl (nf_vstep N) (N.tm.initCfg x) =
      N.tm.runWith (w.take r) (N.tm.initCfg x) :=
    fun r hr => nf_vrun_of_ok N x rs r hr (fun r' h' i => hok i r' (by omega))
  have hfin := hgen rs.length le_rfl
  rw [List.take_length, ← hwlen, List.take_length] at hfin
  -- the control fold follows the virtual run
  have hinit_state : (N.tm.initCfg x).state = some N.tm.q₀ := by
    rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state]
  have hinit_out : StepBlock.outputSummary (N.tm.initCfg x).output = none := by
    rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_output, StepBlock.outputSummary_nil]
  obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := nf_vrun_ctl N rs (N.tm.initCfg x) (some N.tm.q₀, none, false)
    hinit_state.symm hinit_out.symm
  rw [hfin] at hc1 hc2
  have hsw : (rs.flatMap List.ofFn).foldl (nf_sweepStep N) (nf_sweepInit N) =
      ((0, fun _ => none),
        rs.foldl (fun d r => nf_complete N (fun p => some (r p)) d) (some N.tm.q₀, none, false)) :=
    nf_sweep_records N rs _
  rw [hsw] at hctl
  have hout := nf_sweepPass_output N _ _ hc2 hctl
  have hhalt : (rs.foldl (fun d r => nf_complete N (fun p => some (r p)) d)
      (some N.tm.q₀, none, false)).1 = none := by
    unfold nf_sweepPass at hctl
    rw [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true] at hctl
    exact Option.isNone_iff_eq_none.mp hctl.1.1.2
  rw [hc1] at hhalt
  exact FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨w, hwlen, hhalt, hout⟩

/-- **The backward transfer.** If some choice word halts the normal form's host with output
exactly `[true]`, then `N` accepts `x` at some length.

**Proof sketch.** The host's backward acceptance lemma, with `hV`, gives a stream that first stops
the controller and on which the verifier's first verdict is `acc`. The stream is a stream of
records, and the characterization's first verdict is the same time, since the verifier is at no
verdict before either; so every check passes, and the passing stream is a genuine accepting run. -/
private theorem nf_backward_host (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x w : List Bool)
    (hh : ((nf_host N).runWith w ((nf_host N).initCfg x)).state = none)
    (ho : ((nf_host N).runWith w ((nf_host N).initCfg x)).output = [true]) :
    ∃ t', N.AcceptsWithin x t' := by
  obtain ⟨h0, hst, hfi, hbl, hlf⟩ := nf_setup nf_P x 0
  obtain ⟨s, hslive, hsstop, TQ, hacc, hfirst, -⟩ := guessCtlRunTM_stream_of_accepts nf_P nf_P.q₀ 0
    ((0 : Fin (2 * N.k + 4)), false) (nf_ctlStep N.k) (nf_ctlStop N.k)
    (nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)) ⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ ⟨.park, true⟩
    ⟨.park, false⟩ 0 (nf_P.initCfg x) h0 hst hfi hbl hlf (fun s hl hs => nf_hV N x s hl hs) w hh
    ho
  rw [nf_entry] at hacc hfirst
  obtain ⟨rs, hne, rfl, hflag⟩ := nf_split N.k s hslive hsstop
  obtain ⟨TQ', hv', hf', hacc', -⟩ := nf_V_char N x rs hne hflag
  have hTQ : TQ = TQ' := by
    let V := nf_V N (nf_leaf N) (nf_leafExit N)
    let st : Cfg 2 Bool (Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i) x := streamStartCfg x 0
      (⟨.ctl, ScanPhase.fwd (nf_sweepInit N)⟩ : Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i) (rs.flatMap List.ofFn)
    let F : Set (Option (Σ i, nf_St N (nf_LeafSt N) i)) :=
      {some ⟨.park, true⟩, some ⟨.park, false⟩}
    have h1 : Segment V F (fun _ => True) st (V.runFrom st TQ) TQ :=
      (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨rfl, fun u hu hm => by
        rcases hm with hm | hm
        · exact (hfirst u hu).1 hm
        · exact (hfirst u hu).2 hm, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
    have h2 : Segment V F (fun _ => True) st (V.runFrom st TQ') TQ' :=
      (segment_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨rfl, fun u hu hm => by
        rcases hm with hm | hm
        · exact hf' u hu true hm
        · exact hf' u hu false hm, fun _ _ => trivial⟩
    exact Segment.time_eq h1 (Or.inl hacc) h2 hv'
  subst hTQ
  exact ⟨rs.length, nf_backward N x rs (hacc'.mp hacc)⟩

end

/-- **The linear-overhead coded normal form** ([BGW70]-style guess-then-verify,
cited through [AB09, §3.2]): every
nondeterministic machine has a coded (two-work-tape) equivalent whose
acceptance tracks the original's at linear time overhead — forward with the
explicit constant, backward in unbounded form (the consumer recovers the
budgeted form from the original's all-branch halting by the truncation
argument, `Turing.NDTM.runWith_of_halt`).

**Proof sketch.** Guess, then verify; this is why codes carry two work tapes.
1. On work tape `0` the simulator guesses a display: one record of `2k + 4` bits per step of
   `N`, holding the step's choice bit, the claimed reads of the input and of each of the `k` work
   tapes (two bits each: `00` blank, `10` false, `11` true) and an end flag, set on the last
   record only. The guess stops at the first record boundary after a set end flag. States and
   actions are not guessed: the verifier recomputes them from `N`'s table in its finite control.
2. A deterministic, silent verifier then reads the display. A control sweep checks the
   recomputed states, the end flags and the output. Replay sweeps check the claimed reads: one
   against the input, and one per work tape `j` of `N` against tape `j` replayed on work tape `1`,
   kept there as one two-cell block per visited cell and rewritten at every record. Between
   sweeps the heads return and the blocks are erased.
3. Each phase is linear in the display, so the simulator runs within `C · (t + 1)` steps, with
   `C = 6W + k(2W + 12) + 21 + 15k` and `W = 2k + 4`: the time is at most
   `(6W + k(2W + 12)) t + 21 + 15k`, and `t + 1` absorbs the additive terms. At `k = 0` the base
   terms still pay for the guess and the control and input sweeps.
4. Forward transfer: a genuine accepting run of length `t` yields an accepting display, guessed
   and verified within `C · (t + 1)`. Backward transfer: a verified display **is** a genuine run
   (the sweeps force consistency), so an accepting branch of the simulator exhibits an accepting
   branch of `N` at some length — unbounded on purpose: runaway guessing branches never accept,
   and no all-branch-halting claim is made for the simulator.
5. The finite state space is relabeled to `Fin`.

**Implementation.** The guess runs under the controller-stopped host `Turing.guessCtlRunTM` with
a trivial setup. The control sweep is a fold by `Turing.scanTM`. A work-tape replay does not
perform the last record's head move, so the blocks stay contiguous around the head. Between sweeps
`Turing.skipTM` and `Turing.skipBackTM` return the heads and `Turing.clearTM` erases the blocks.
The relabeling is `Turing.NDTM.relabelState` (the nondeterministic mirror of
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.relabelState`, as in the `exists_codeTM` precedent). -/
theorem exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear (N : FinNDTM Bool) :
    ∃ (M : CodeNDTM) (C : ℕ),
      (∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        N.AcceptsWithin x t → M.toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x (C * (t + 1))) ∧
      (∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
        M.toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t → ∃ t', N.AcceptsWithin x t') := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := nf_pack (nf_host N)
  refine ⟨M, nf_C N.k, fun x t hN => (hM x _).2 (nf_forward N x t hN), fun x t hMt => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w, -, hh, ho⟩ := (hM x t).1 hMt
  exact nf_backward_host N x w hh ho

end FinNDTM

end Turing
```

```
/-

Authors: Seyoon Ragavan

import TCSlib.Complexity.Formulas.QBFEncoding
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ConfigGraph
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Constructible
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Inclusions
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.CfgRecord
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Correct
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHard

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# `PSPACE`-completeness and `TQBF`

[AB09, §4.2]: `PSPACE`-hardness and -completeness (Definition 4.9), the
adjacency-formula half of Claim 4.4(2), and the Stockmeyer-Meyer theorem that
`TQBF` is `PSPACE`-complete (Theorem 4.13). Phase P4.3 of
`AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md`.

## Design

* **Def 4.9 verbatim over the campaign's `≤ₚ`** (`Complexity.PolyTimeReducible`,
  chapter 2); the logspace-reduction variant ([AB09, Exercise 4.9]) waits for
  phase P4.4's `≤ₗ`.
* **Claim 4.4(2) at polynomial size**, in the packaged quotient form
  `Complexity.exists_adjacency_codec_cnf`. For each machine there is a constant `C` such that
  for all `(n, s)` there are a configuration bit-codec of length `C · (s + n + 1)`, **factoring
  through the input and the P4.2 vertex quotient** `Turing.NDTM.coreSum` — full configurations
  are *not* injectively codable at fixed length, the output tape being unbounded (round-1
  blocker, finding 1) — and **three** CNFs over the code bits: a validity predicate
  characterizing exactly the codec image (unguarded midpoint quantification admits paths
  through junk codes — round-1 finding 3), the adjacency test (true on same-input windowed
  pairs iff the step descends to the vertex quotient; false across distinct inputs), and the
  acceptance test (halted state with `accept` summary).
  Declared deviations from the book's Claim 4.4(2), each argued harmless to
  Theorem 4.13: (i) the codec length is `O(s + n)` rather than `O(s)` — the
  code carries the **input content** and a one-hot input-position track, so
  every check is *local* and the formulas are input-independent (Cook-Levin's
  marker discipline; round-1 finding 7); (ii) the CNF sizes are bounded
  through their **serialized lengths** — polynomial, not linear; a
  literal-occurrence count alone misses empty clauses (round-1 finding 8) —
  at base `s + n + 2`, which gives the description room the code width does
  not (round-2 finding 1);
  (iii) adjacency compares `coreSum (step c)` with `coreSum d`, so halted
  vertices are self-adjacent while live ones **need not** be (a stationary
  silent live loop is — round-2 finding 3); the ψ-recursion's base case
  supplies `a = b` separately (round-1 finding 6). No proof uses this statement: the hardness
  proof `Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEHard` goes through the configuration codes of
  `Complexity.Codec` and a P-uniform tableau (`ClassPSPACE/TQBFHard*.lean`), and the
  phase-P4.4 `PATH` reduction uses `Complexity.Codec` as well.
* **The facade discipline**: `ClassPSPACE.lean` is this phase's own new
  facade; nothing frozen is touched.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.PSPACEHard`, `Complexity.PSPACEComplete` — [AB09, Definition 4.9].
* `Complexity.TQBF` — the true quantified Boolean formulas, over
  `Complexity.QBF.decode`. [AB09, §4.2, before Theorem 4.13]

## Main results

* `Complexity.PSPACE_eq_P_of_pspaceComplete_mem_P` — a `PSPACE`-complete
  language in `P` collapses `PSPACE` to `P`. [AB09, §4.2, after Definition 4.9]
* `Complexity.exists_adjacency_codec_cnf` — [AB09, Claim 4.4(2)], packaged quotient form (no
  proof uses it).
* `Complexity.TQBF_mem_PSPACE` — [AB09, Theorem 4.13, membership half].
* `Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEHard` — [AB09, Theorem 4.13, hardness half]; proved in
  `ClassPSPACE/TQBFHard*.lean` (the `ψᵢ` recursion with a tableau-and-Tseitin matrix).
* `Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEComplete` — [AB09, Theorem 4.13].

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, Definition 4.9, Claim 4.4,
  Theorem 4.13; Claim 2.13, p. 46, for the gate templates.)
* [SM73] L. Stockmeyer, A. Meyer, *Word problems requiring exponential time*,
  STOC 1973. (Cited through [AB09]; no external text required.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Std.Sat (CNF)
open Turing

/-- **`PSPACE`-hardness** [AB09, Definition 4.9]: every `PSPACE` language
Karp-reduces to `L'` in polynomial time. (The logspace variant is phase
P4.4's.) -/
def PSPACEHard (L' : Language Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ L ∈ PSPACE, L ≤ₚ L'

/-- **`PSPACE`-completeness** [AB09, Definition 4.9]: `PSPACE`-hard and in
`PSPACE`. -/
def PSPACEComplete (L' : Language Bool) : Prop :=
  L' ∈ PSPACE ∧ PSPACEHard L'

/-- **A `PSPACE`-complete language in `P` collapses the class**
([AB09, §4.2, the paragraph after Definition 4.9]; proved, citing `P_subset_PSPACE`):
if some `PSPACE`-complete `L'` lies in `P`, then `PSPACE = P`.

**Proof sketch.** `⊇` is `Complexity.P_subset_PSPACE` (phase P4.1). `⊆`: a
`PSPACE` member reduces to `L'` (hardness), and `P` is closed downward under
`≤ₚ` (`Complexity.mem_P_of_polyTimeReducible`, chapter 2). -/
theorem PSPACE_eq_P_of_pspaceComplete_mem_P {L' : Language Bool}
    (h : PSPACEComplete L') (hP : L' ∈ P) : PSPACE = P := by
  exact Set.Subset.antisymm
    (fun L hL => mem_P_of_polyTimeReducible (h.2 L hL) hP) P_subset_PSPACE

/-! ### Fill appendix: finite marker tracks for the quotient codec

The finite row below factors through `ConfigCount.coreCode`. Its Boolean coordinates
are the input contents, one-hot input head and state, three bits per work cell
(two mutually exclusive symbol bits and one head marker), and two summary bits.
Coordinates are numbered by a finite equivalence; the rest of the prescribed width
is zero padding. No output history other than `outSummary` is retained.

For adjacency, each joint head tuple and finite scanned-symbol/state case guards
one output-coordinate gate. Its `3k+7` ports include the guard markers, the scanned
input and work bits, the summary flags, and the old/new coordinate. Thus every use
of Boolean universality has machine-only arity. Exact integer successor markers
reject outward moves; the code itself is only compared on windowed configurations.
Normalizing the output history before a transition uses `NDTM.coreSum_stepWith`.
With `u=s+n+2`, the validity and acceptance ledgers have degree three, and adjacency
has degree `k+3`. A single constant absorbs all coefficients and the padded width.
-/

/-- The finite fields of a windowed configuration, together with its input. -/
private structure CodecRow (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) where
  input : Fin n → Bool
  state : Option M.State
  inputHead : Fin (n + 2)
  symbols : Fin M.k → Fin (2 * s + 1) → Option Bool
  heads : Fin M.k → Fin (2 * s + 1)
  summary : OutSummary

/-- One coordinate for each bit in the marker discipline of Claim 4.4(2). -/
private inductive CodecBit (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
  | input : Fin n → CodecBit M n s
  | inputHead : Fin (n + 2) → CodecBit M n s
  | state : Option M.State → CodecBit M n s
  | work : Fin M.k → Fin (2 * s + 1) → Fin 3 → CodecBit M n s
  | summary : Bool → CodecBit M n s
  deriving Fintype, DecidableEq

/-- The unpadded track width, with three bits for every work cell. -/
private theorem codecBit_card (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (CodecBit M n s) =
      n + (n + 2) + (Fintype.card M.State + 1) + M.k * (2 * s + 1) * 3 + 2 := by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (CodecBit.proxyTypeEquiv M n s)]
  simp
  ring

/-- A machine-dependent linear coefficient sufficient for all raw tracks. -/
private def codecCoefficient (M : FinTM Bool) : ℕ :=
  Fintype.card M.State + 6 * M.k + 5

/-- The raw tracks fit every requested width with coefficient at least this one. -/
private theorem codecBit_card_le (M : FinTM Bool) (n s C : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) :
    Fintype.card (CodecBit M n s) ≤ C * (s + n + 1) := by
  rw [codecBit_card]
  unfold codecCoefficient at hC
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card M.State + 6 * M.k + 5) * (s + n + 1) := by nlinarith
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hC

/-- Marker encoding of a finite row. Blank symbols and the empty summary use `00`;
false/true symbols and accept/dead summaries use the two singleton patterns. -/
private def codecRowBits {M : FinTM Bool} {n s : ℕ} (r : CodecRow M n s) :
    CodecBit M n s → Bool
  | .input i => r.input i
  | .inputHead j => decide (r.inputHead = j)
  | .state q => decide (r.state = q)
  | .work i j b =>
      if b.val = 0 then decide (r.symbols i j = some false)
      else if b.val = 1 then decide (r.symbols i j = some true)
      else decide (r.heads i = j)
  | .summary b => decide (r.summary = if b then .dead else .accept)

/-- Two singleton flags distinguish all three values of an optional bit. -/
private theorem codec_symbol_ext (u v : Option Bool)
    (h0 : decide (u = some false) = decide (v = some false))
    (h1 : decide (u = some true) = decide (v = some true)) : u = v := by
  cases u with
  | none => cases v with
    | none => rfl
    | some b => cases b <;> simp_all
  | some a => cases v with
    | none => cases a <;> simp_all
    | some b => cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

/-- Marker equality recovers every field of a finite row.

**Proof sketch.** Read the true marker at the first row's state and head positions.
The two symbol flags distinguish blank, false and true; the two summary flags
similarly distinguish the three output summaries. Input bits are direct coordinates. -/
private theorem codecRowBits_injective {M : FinTM Bool} {n s : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (@codecRowBits M n s) := by
  intro r t h
  have hi : r.input = t.input := funext fun j => congrFun h (.input j)
  have hs : r.state = t.state := by
    have := congrFun h (.state r.state)
    exact Eq.symm (of_decide_eq_true (show decide (t.state = r.state) = true from by
      simpa only [codecRowBits, decide_true] using this.symm))
  have hp : r.inputHead = t.inputHead := by
    have := congrFun h (.inputHead r.inputHead)
    exact Eq.symm (of_decide_eq_true (show decide (t.inputHead = r.inputHead) = true from by
      simpa only [codecRowBits, decide_true] using this.symm))
  have hw : r.symbols = t.symbols := by
    funext i j
    apply codec_symbol_ext
    · exact congrFun h (.work i j 0)
    · exact congrFun h (.work i j 1)
  have hh : r.heads = t.heads := by
    funext i
    have := congrFun h (.work i (r.heads i) 2)
    exact Eq.symm (of_decide_eq_true (show decide (t.heads i = r.heads i) = true from by
      simpa [codecRowBits] using this.symm))
  have ho : r.summary = t.summary := by
    have h0 := congrFun h (.summary false)
    have h1 := congrFun h (.summary true)
    cases hr : r.summary <;> cases ht : t.summary <;>
      simp_all [codecRowBits]
  cases r
  cases t
  cases hi
  cases hs
  cases hp
  cases hw
  cases hh
  cases ho
  rfl

/-- Restriction of a configuration to its finite core code, with input and summary. -/
private def codecRowOf (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (x : List Bool)
    (hx : x.length = n) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : CodecRow M n s :=
  let t := MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode s c
  { input := fun i => x.getD i.val false
    state := t.1
    inputHead := ⟨t.2.1.val, by simpa [hx] using t.2.1.isLt⟩
    symbols := t.2.2.1
    heads := t.2.2.2
    summary := outSummary c.output }

/-- Equality of the finite rows recovers the input content. -/
private theorem codecRowOf_input_eq (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
    (x y : List Bool) (hx : x.length = n) (hy : y.length = n)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y)
    (h : (codecRowOf M n s x hx c).input = (codecRowOf M n s y hy d).input) : x = y := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · omega
  · intro i hix hiy
    have he := congrFun h ⟨i, by omega⟩
    simpa [codecRowOf, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem, hix, hiy] using he

/-- The finite row identifies exactly the configuration-graph vertex at a fixed input.

**Proof sketch.** Forward, the four finite core fields agree, so `coreCode_inj`
recovers the core using the window bounds; the fifth field supplies the summary.
Backward, equality of cores and summaries directly makes all finite fields equal. -/
private theorem codecRowOf_eq_iff (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
    (x : List Bool) (hx : x.length = n) (c d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x)
    (hc : c.InWindow s) (hd : d.InWindow s) :
    codecRowOf M n s x hx c = codecRowOf M n s x hx d ↔
      NDTM.coreSum c = NDTM.coreSum d := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode_inj s hc.core_bounds hd.core_bounds
      apply Prod.ext (congrArg CodecRow.state h)
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Fin.ext
        exact congrArg (fun r => r.inputHead.val) h
      · exact Prod.ext (congrArg CodecRow.symbols h) (congrArg CodecRow.heads h)
    · exact congrArg CodecRow.summary h
  · intro h
    have hc := congrArg Prod.fst h
    have ho := congrArg Prod.snd h
    change MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.core c = MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.core d at hc
    change outSummary c.output = outSummary d.output at ho
    simp only [MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.core, Prod.mk.injEq] at hc
    rcases hc with ⟨hs, hp, hw, hh⟩
    simp only [codecRowOf, MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode, hs, hp, hw, hh, ho]

/-- Pad an arbitrary finite bit assignment to exactly `L` bits (truncate if necessary).
The application below always proves that truncation cannot occur. -/
private noncomputable def codecWord {α : Type} [Fintype α] (L : ℕ) (a : α → Bool) :
    List Bool :=
  List.ofFn fun i : Fin L =>
    if h : i.val < Fintype.card α then
      a ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm ⟨i.val, h⟩)
    else false

/-- The padded word has its prescribed length on all arguments. -/
private theorem codecWord_length {α : Type} [Fintype α] (L : ℕ) (a : α → Bool) :
    (codecWord L a).length = L := by simp [codecWord]

/-- Reading the coordinate of a finite bit assignment after sufficient padding. -/
private theorem codecWord_get {α : Type} [Fintype α] (L : ℕ) (a : α → Bool)
    (hL : Fintype.card α ≤ L) (i : α) :
    (codecWord L a).getD (Fintype.equivFin α i).val false = a i := by
  have hi := (Fintype.equivFin α i).isLt
  simp [codecWord, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hi, lt_of_lt_of_le hi hL]

/-- Sufficiently padded words agree exactly when their underlying bits agree. -/
private theorem codecWord_eq_iff {α : Type} [Fintype α] (L : ℕ)
    (hL : Fintype.card α ≤ L) (a b : α → Bool) :
    codecWord L a = codecWord L b ↔ a = b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i
    have he := congrArg (fun w : List Bool => w.getD (Fintype.equivFin α i).val false) h
    simpa only [codecWord_get L a hL i, codecWord_get L b hL i] using he
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

/-- The total configuration codec. Wrong-length inputs receive the all-zero word. -/
private noncomputable def configurationCodec (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (x : List Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) : List Bool :=
  if hx : x.length = n then
    codecWord (C * (s + n + 1)) (codecRowBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx c))
  else List.replicate (C * (s + n + 1)) false

/-- Exact length holds even for wrong-length inputs and nonwindowed configurations. -/
private theorem configurationCodec_length (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (x : List Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) :
    (configurationCodec M C n s x c).length = C * (s + n + 1) := by
  unfold configurationCodec
  split <;> simp [codecWord_length]

/-- The codec separates inputs of the prescribed length. -/
private theorem configurationCodec_input_eq (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) (x y : List Bool)
    (hx : x.length = n) (hy : y.length = n)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y)
    (h : configurationCodec M C n s x c = configurationCodec M C n s y d) : x = y := by
  simp only [configurationCodec, dif_pos hx, dif_pos hy] at h
  have hbits := (codecWord_eq_iff _ (codecBit_card_le M n s C hC) _ _).mp h
  exact codecRowOf_input_eq M n s x y hx hy c d (congrArg CodecRow.input (codecRowBits_injective hbits))

/-- The padded codec factors through, and separates, the windowed vertex quotient. -/
private theorem configurationCodec_eq_iff (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) (x : List Bool) (hx : x.length = n)
    (c d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (hd : d.InWindow s) :
    configurationCodec M C n s x c = configurationCodec M C n s x d ↔
      NDTM.coreSum c = NDTM.coreSum d := by
  simp only [configurationCodec, dif_pos hx,
    codecWord_eq_iff _ (codecBit_card_le M n s C hC), codecRowBits_injective.eq_iff]
  exact codecRowOf_eq_iff M n s x hx c d hc hd

/-- A flattened family conjoins exactly its member formulas. -/
private theorem codecCnf_eval_flatMap {α β : Type} (xs : List β) (f : β → CNF α)
    (a : α → Bool) : CNF.eval a (xs.flatMap f) = true ↔ ∀ i ∈ xs, (f i).eval a = true := by
  simp [CNF.eval, List.all_flatMap, List.all_eq_true]

/-- A list of clauses conjoins their individual evaluations. -/
private theorem codecCnf_eval_map {α β : Type} (xs : List β) (f : β → CNF.Clause α)
    (a : α → Bool) : CNF.eval a (xs.map f) = true ↔ ∀ i ∈ xs, (f i).eval a = true := by
  simp [CNF.eval, List.all_eq_true]

/-- Exactly one positive marker, expressed by one positive clause and pairwise exclusions. -/
private noncomputable def codecOneHot (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : CNF α :=
  [(Finset.univ.toList.map fun i : α => (i, true))] ++
    Finset.univ.toList.flatMap fun i : α =>
      (Finset.univ.toList.filter fun j : α => decide (i ≠ j)).map fun j =>
        [(i, false), (j, false)]

/-- Pairwise exclusions give precisely a one-hot assignment.

**Proof sketch.** The positive clause selects a true coordinate. Its exclusion clause
with any other coordinate forces that other coordinate false. Conversely, an assignment
with a single true coordinate satisfies the positive clause and every exclusion. -/
private theorem codecOneHot_eval (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (a : α → Bool) :
    (codecOneHot α).eval a = true ↔ ∃ j : α, ∀ i : α, a i = decide (j = i) := by
  classical
  have he : (codecOneHot α).eval a = true ↔
      (∃ j : α, a j = true) ∧ ∀ i j : α, i ≠ j → (a i = false ∨ a j = false) := by
    simp [codecOneHot, CNF.eval, CNF.Clause.eval, List.all_flatMap,
      List.all_filter, Bool.or_eq_true]
    intro _ _
    constructor
    · intro h i j hij
      exact (h i j).resolve_left hij
    · intro h i j
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · exact Or.inl hij
      · exact Or.inr (h i j hij)
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨j, hj⟩, hpair⟩
    refine ⟨j, fun i => ?_⟩
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst i
      simpa using hj
    · have hi := hpair j i hji
      simpa [hji, hj] using hi
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    refine ⟨⟨j, by simpa using hj j⟩, ?_⟩
    intro u v huv
    by_cases hju : j = u
    · right
      have hjv : j ≠ v := by simpa [hju] using huv
      simpa [hjv] using hj v
    · left
      simpa [hju] using hj u

/-- Valid marker assignments consist of one-hot heads and state, with the forbidden
`11` pattern excluded from each symbol and summary pair. -/
private def codecBitsValid (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (a : CodecBit M n s → Bool) : Prop :=
  (∃ j : Fin (n + 2), ∀ i, a (.inputHead i) = decide (j = i)) ∧
  (∃ q : Option M.State, ∀ p, a (.state p) = decide (q = p)) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin M.k, ∃ h : Fin (2 * s + 1),
    ∀ j, a (.work i j 2) = decide (h = j)) ∧
  (∀ i j, a (.work i j 0) = false ∨ a (.work i j 1) = false) ∧
  (a (.summary false) = false ∨ a (.summary true) = false)

/-- Every finite row produces a valid marker assignment. -/
private theorem codecRowBits_valid {M : FinTM Bool} {n s : ℕ} (r : CodecRow M n s) :
    codecBitsValid M n s (codecRowBits r) := by
  refine ⟨⟨r.inputHead, fun _ => rfl⟩, ⟨r.state, fun _ => rfl⟩,
    (fun i => ⟨r.heads i, fun _ => rfl⟩), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    cases h : r.symbols i j with
    | none => simp [codecRowBits, h]
    | some b => cases b <;> simp [codecRowBits, h]
  · cases h : r.summary <;> simp [codecRowBits, h]

/-- Every valid marker assignment is the encoding of a finite row.

**Proof sketch.** Choose the unique head and state markers. Decode each two-bit symbol
pair as false, true or blank; its exclusion rules out `11`. Decode the summary in the
same way. Each coordinate of the constructed row then has the prescribed bit. -/
private theorem codecBitsValid_iff (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
    (a : CodecBit M n s → Bool) :
    codecBitsValid M n s a ↔ ∃ r : CodecRow M n s, codecRowBits r = a := by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨ip, hip⟩, ⟨q, hq⟩, hh, hw, ho⟩
    choose hp hhp using hh
    let r : CodecRow M n s :=
      { input := fun i => a (.input i)
        state := q
        inputHead := ip
        symbols := fun i j => if a (.work i j 0) then some false
          else if a (.work i j 1) then some true else none
        heads := hp
        summary := if a (.summary false) then .accept
          else if a (.summary true) then .dead else .empty }
    refine ⟨r, funext fun z => ?_⟩
    cases z with
    | input i => rfl
    | inputHead i => exact (hip i).symm
    | state p => exact (hq p).symm
    | work i j b =>
      have hij := hw i j
      fin_cases b <;>
        cases h0 : a (.work i j 0) <;> cases h1 : a (.work i j 1) <;>
        simp_all [codecRowBits, r]
    | summary b =>
      cases b <;> cases h0 : a (.summary false) <;>
        cases h1 : a (.summary true) <;> simp_all [codecRowBits, r]
  · rintro ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact codecRowBits_valid r

/-- The validity CNF on unpadded tracks. Input contents are unrestricted. -/
private noncomputable def codecValidity (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) : CNF (CodecBit M n s) :=
  (codecOneHot (Fin (n + 2))).relabel CodecBit.inputHead ++
  (codecOneHot (Option M.State)).relabel CodecBit.state ++
  (List.finRange M.k).flatMap (fun i =>
    (codecOneHot (Fin (2 * s + 1))).relabel (fun j => CodecBit.work i j 2)) ++
  (List.finRange M.k).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange (2 * s + 1)).map fun j =>
    [(CodecBit.work i j 0, false), (CodecBit.work i j 1, false)]) ++
  [[(CodecBit.summary false, false), (CodecBit.summary true, false)]]

/-- The unpadded validity formula recognizes exactly the finite-row encodings. -/
private theorem codecValidity_eval (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
    (a : CodecBit M n s → Bool) :
    (codecValidity M n s).eval a = true ↔ ∃ r : CodecRow M n s, codecRowBits r = a := by
  rw [← codecBitsValid_iff]
  simp [codecValidity, codecBitsValid, CNF.eval_append, CNF.eval_relabel,
    codecOneHot_eval, codecCnf_eval_flatMap, codecCnf_eval_map, CNF.Clause.eval,
    Bool.or_eq_true]

/-- The finite position code decodes the designated cell of the window. -/
private theorem codec_posCode (s : ℕ) (j : Fin (2 * s + 1)) :
    MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.posCode s ((j.val : ℤ) - s) = j := by
  apply Fin.ext
  dsimp [MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.posCode]
  have hj := j.isLt
  omega

/-- Every finite row is realized by a genuine windowed configuration.

**Proof sketch.** Turn the input vector into a list and extend the finite work tracks
by blanks outside the window. Subtract the radius to recover work-head positions.
Use respectively `[]`, `[true]` and `[false]` for the three summaries. Reading the
finite core code of this configuration returns exactly the original row. -/
private theorem codecRow_realize (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (r : CodecRow M n s) :
    ∃ (x : List Bool) (hx : x.length = n) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x),
      c.InWindow s ∧ codecRowOf M n s x hx c = r := by
  let x := List.ofFn r.input
  have hx : x.length = n := by simp [x]
  let c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x :=
    { state := r.state
      inputPos := ⟨r.inputHead.val, by rw [hx]; exact r.inputHead.isLt⟩
      workTapes := fun i z => if |z| ≤ (s : ℤ) then
        r.symbols i (MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.posCode s z) else none
      workTapePos := fun i => (r.heads i).val - (s : ℤ)
      output := match r.summary with
        | .empty => []
        | .accept => [true]
        | .dead => [false] }
  have hz (j : Fin (2 * s + 1)) : |(j.val : ℤ) - s| ≤ (s : ℤ) := by
    have hj := j.isLt
    rw [abs_le]
    omega
  refine ⟨x, hx, c, ⟨fun i => hz (r.heads i), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro i z h
    simp [c, not_le_of_gt h]
  · have hi : (fun i : Fin n => x.getD i.val false) = r.input := by
      funext i
      simp [x, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    have hw : (fun (i : Fin M.k) (j : Fin (2 * s + 1)) => c.workTapes i ((j.val : ℤ) - s)) = r.symbols := by
      funext i j
      simp [c, hz j, codec_posCode]
    have hh : (fun i => MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.posCode s (c.workTapePos i)) = r.heads := by
      funext i
      exact codec_posCode s (r.heads i)
    have ho : outSummary c.output = r.summary := by
      cases h : r.summary <;> simp [c, h, outSummary]
    dsimp [codecRowOf, MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode]
    rw [hi, hw, hh, ho]

/-- A padded word's unused suffix is zero. -/
private theorem codecWord_padding {α : Type} [Fintype α] (L : ℕ) (a : α → Bool)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : Fintype.card α ≤ j) : (codecWord L a).getD j false = false := by
  by_cases hL : j < L
  · simp [codecWord, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hL, not_lt_of_ge hj]
  · simp [codecWord, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hL]

/-- A word of length `L` with zero padding is recovered from its finite coordinates. -/
private theorem codecWord_reconstruct {α : Type} [Fintype α] (L : ℕ)
    (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = L)
    (hpad : ∀ j, Fintype.card α ≤ j → j < L → w.getD j false = false) :
    codecWord L (fun i : α => w.getD (Fintype.equivFin α i).val false) = w := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simpa [codecWord_length] using hw.symm
  · intro i hi hiw
    have hiL : i < L := by simpa only [codecWord_length] using hi
    by_cases hiα : i < Fintype.card α
    · simp [codecWord, hiα, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hiw]
    · have he := hpad i (by omega) hiL
      simpa [codecWord, hiα, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hiw] using he.symm

/-- The padding clauses fix every unused coordinate to false. -/
private def codecPadding (first L : ℕ) : CNF ℕ :=
  (List.range (L - first)).map fun i => [(first + i, false)]

/-- Evaluation of the padding clauses states exactly that the unused suffix is zero. -/
private theorem codecPadding_eval (first L : ℕ) (a : ℕ → Bool) :
    (codecPadding first L).eval a = true ↔ ∀ j, first ≤ j → j < L → a j = false := by
  simp only [codecPadding, CNF.eval, List.all_map, List.all_eq_true, List.mem_range,
    Function.comp_apply, CNF.Clause.eval_cons, CNF.Clause.eval_nil, Bool.or_false,
    beq_iff_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj hjL
    simpa [Nat.add_sub_of_le hj] using h (j - first) (by omega)
  · intro h i hi
    exact h (first + i) (by omega) (by omega)

/-- Number the finite validity formula inside the prescribed width and add zero padding. -/
private noncomputable def configurationValidity (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ) : CNF ℕ :=
  (codecValidity M n s).relabel (fun b => (Fintype.equivFin (CodecBit M n s) b).val) ++
    codecPadding (Fintype.card (CodecBit M n s)) (C * (s + n + 1))

/-- Validity recognizes exactly the padded codes of windowed configurations.

**Proof sketch.** The unpadded formula recovers a finite row and the padding clauses
recover the remaining zeros. Realize that row by the window extension lemma.
Conversely every configuration supplies a valid row and zero padding. -/
private theorem configurationValidity_eval (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = C * (s + n + 1)) :
    (configurationValidity M C n s).eval (fun j => w.getD j false) = true ↔
      ∃ x : List Bool, x.length = n ∧ ∃ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x,
        c.InWindow s ∧ w = configurationCodec M C n s x c := by
  have hfit := codecBit_card_le M n s C hC
  simp only [configurationValidity, CNF.eval_append, Bool.and_eq_true, CNF.eval_relabel,
    codecValidity_eval, codecPadding_eval, Function.comp_def]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, c, hc, he⟩ := codecRow_realize M n s r
    refine ⟨x, hx, c, hc, ?_⟩
    simp only [configurationCodec, dif_pos hx, he, hr]
    exact (codecWord_reconstruct _ w hw hp).symm
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, c, hc, rfl⟩
    simp only [configurationCodec, dif_pos hx]
    refine ⟨⟨codecRowOf M n s x hx c, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · funext b
      exact (codecWord_get _ _ hfit b).symm
    · intro j hj _
      exact codecWord_padding _ _ j hj

/-- Acceptance reads the halt marker and the accepting summary marker. -/
private def codecAcceptance (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) : CNF (CodecBit M n s) :=
  [[(.state none, true)], [(.summary false, true)]]

/-- The acceptance formula has the required meaning on every finite row. -/
private theorem codecAcceptance_eval (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (r : CodecRow M n s) :
    (codecAcceptance M n s).eval (codecRowBits r) = true ↔
      r.state = none ∧ r.summary = .accept := by
  simp [codecAcceptance, CNF.eval, CNF.Clause.eval, codecRowBits]

/-- Number the two acceptance tests at their actual code positions. -/
private noncomputable def configurationAcceptance (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) : CNF ℕ :=
  (codecAcceptance M n s).relabel (fun b => (Fintype.equivFin (CodecBit M n s) b).val)

/-- The numbered acceptance CNF recognizes halted configurations with accepting summary. -/
private theorem configurationAcceptance_eval (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) (x : List Bool) (hx : x.length = n)
    (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) :
    (configurationAcceptance M n s).eval (fun j => (configurationCodec M C n s x c).getD j false)
      = true ↔ c.state = none ∧ outSummary c.output = .accept := by
  simp only [configurationAcceptance, CNF.eval_relabel, Function.comp_def,
    configurationCodec, dif_pos hx, codecWord_get _ _ (codecBit_card_le M n s C hC)]
  exact codecAcceptance_eval M n s (codecRowOf M n s x hx c)

/-- Clause count plus literal occurrences; empty clauses still cost one unit. -/
private def codecCnfCost {α : Type} (φ : CNF α) : ℕ :=
  (φ.map fun clause => clause.length + 1).sum

/-- Renumbering variables preserves the clause-and-literal cost. -/
private theorem codecCnfCost_relabel {α β : Type} (φ : CNF α) (f : α → β) :
    codecCnfCost (φ.relabel f) = codecCnfCost φ := by
  simp [codecCnfCost, CNF.relabel, CNF.Clause.relabel, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

/-- Conjoining CNFs adds their clause-and-literal costs. -/
private theorem codecCnfCost_append {α : Type} (φ ψ : CNF α) :
    codecCnfCost (φ ++ ψ) = codecCnfCost φ + codecCnfCost ψ := by
  simp [codecCnfCost]

/-- A family of bounded-cost checks has at most its length times the common cost. -/
private theorem codecCnfCost_flatMap_le {α β : Type} (xs : List β) (f : β → CNF α)
    (B : ℕ) (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, codecCnfCost (f x) ≤ B) :
    codecCnfCost (xs.flatMap f) ≤ xs.length * B := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [codecCnfCost]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.flatMap_cons, codecCnfCost_append, List.length_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    exact (Nat.add_le_add (h x List.mem_cons_self)
      (ih fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))).trans_eq (Nat.add_comm _ _)

/-- The exactly-one constraint has a quadratic cost, including its positive clause.

**Proof sketch.** The positive clause costs the number of markers plus one.
There are at most the square of that many ordered exclusions, each costing three. -/
private theorem codecOneHot_cost (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
    codecCnfCost (codecOneHot α) ≤
      Fintype.card α + 1 + 3 * (Fintype.card α) ^ 2 := by
  classical
  let xs := (Finset.univ : Finset α).toList
  have hx : xs.length = Fintype.card α := by simp [xs]
  have hpair (i : α) : codecCnfCost
      ((xs.filter fun j => decide (i ≠ j)).map fun j => [(i, false), (j, false)]) ≤
        Fintype.card α * 3 := by
    simp only [codecCnfCost, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, List.length_cons,
      List.length_nil, Nat.reduceAdd, List.map_const', List.sum_replicate, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right 3 ((List.length_filter_le _ _).trans_eq hx)
  have h := codecCnfCost_flatMap_le xs
    (fun i => (xs.filter fun j => decide (i ≠ j)).map fun j => [(i, false), (j, false)])
    (Fintype.card α * 3) (fun i _ => hpair i)
  unfold codecOneHot
  rw [codecCnfCost_append]
  have hsingle : codecCnfCost [xs.map fun i => (i, true)] = Fintype.card α + 1 := by
    simp [codecCnfCost, hx]
  change codecCnfCost [xs.map fun i => (i, true)] + _ ≤ _
  rw [hsingle]
  rw [hx] at h
  nlinarith

/-- A variable bound for an explicitly bounded relabeling of a finite formula. -/
private theorem codecCnf_numVars {α : Type} (φ : CNF α) (wire : α → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, ∀ l ∈ c, wire l.1 < N) : (CNF.relabel wire φ).numVars ≤ N := by
  apply List.max_le_of_forall_le
  intro j hj
  simp only [CNF.relabel, CNF.Clause.relabel, List.flatMap_map, List.map_map,
    Function.comp_def, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map] at hj
  obtain ⟨clause, hc, lit, hl, rfl⟩ := hj
  exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (hw clause hc lit hl)

/-- The chapter-2 grammar bounds serialization by the cost times the index bound.

**Proof sketch.** A literal at index below `N` serializes to at most `N+2` bits.
Each clause contributes its prefix and terminator, and the formula has one final
terminator. Counting one extra unit per clause covers both separators, including
empty clauses. The bound deliberately allows `N+3` bits per cost unit. -/
private theorem codecCnf_serialize {α : Type} (φ : CNF α) (wire : α → ℕ) (N : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ c ∈ φ, ∀ l ∈ c, wire l.1 < N) :
    (CNF.serialize (CNF.relabel wire φ)).length ≤ codecCnfCost φ * (N + 3) + 1 := by
  have hlit (l : Std.Sat.Literal α) (hl : wire l.1 < N) :
      (CNF.serializeLit (wire l.1, l.2)).length ≤ N + 2 := by
    simp only [CNF.serializeLit, List.length_append, List.length_replicate,
      List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
    omega
  have hclause (c : CNF.Clause α) (hc : ∀ l ∈ c, wire l.1 < N) :
      (CNF.serializeClause (c.relabel wire)).length + 1 ≤ (c.length + 1) * (N + 3) := by
