front end's actual ready configuration, including its arbitrary guard residue. One public
seam joins successful parsing to grammar; one public phase dispatch and one emitting halt
handle each final verdict. No new admission is introduced. -/
private lemma exists_canonDecider (F : MachineFormat) :
    ∃ (D : FinTM Bool) (a : ℕ), ∀ α : List Bool, ∃ b : Bool,
      D.ComputesInTime α [b] (a * (α.length + 1) ^ a) ∧
        (b = false → F.decode α = F.fallback) ∧
        (b = true → ∃ tail, F.scan α = some tail) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, ce, cx, a, wide, cinj, front⟩ := exists_canonParseFront F
  obtain ⟨m, S, finite, equal, G, ge, gx, b, header, ginj, grammar⟩ :=
    exists_canonGrammarStage F
  letI : Fintype S := finite
  letI : DecidableEq S := equal
  let K := C.k + m
  let cb : Fin C.k ↪ Fin K := Fin.castLEEmb (by dsimp [K]; omega)
  let gb : Fin m ↪ Fin K := ⟨fun j =>
    if j = header then ⟨0, by dsimp [K]; omega⟩
    else ⟨C.k + j.val, by have := j.isLt; dsimp [K]; omega⟩, by
      intro i j h
      by_cases hi : i = header <;> by_cases hj : j = header
      · exact hi.trans hj.symm
      · have v := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [if_pos hi, if_neg hj] at v
        omega
      · have v := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [if_neg hi, if_pos hj] at v
        omega
      · have v := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [if_neg hi, if_neg hj] at v
        exact Fin.ext (by omega)⟩
  let A := embedEmitTM cb C.tm
  let B := embedEmitTM gb G
  let P := seamCompTM A (cx true) B ge
  let ports : Option Bool → C.State ⊕ S
    | none => Sum.inl (cx false)
    | some bit => Sum.inr (gx bit)
  have distinct : Function.Injective ports := by
    intro v w h
    cases v <;> cases w
    · rfl
    · cases h
    · cases h
    · exact congrArg some (ginj (Sum.inr.inj h))
  obtain ⟨D, emit⟩ := canonEmitVerdict P (Sum.inl ce) ports distinct
  let degree := a + b + 4
  refine ⟨D, degree, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, bound, v, state, silent, cuts, rejected, ready⟩ := front x
  let start := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) ce (fun _ : Fin K => [])
  let e := A.runFrom start t
  have es : e.state = some (cx v) := by
    dsimp only [e]
    rw [canonBlankLift C.tm cb]
    exact state
  have eo : e.output = [] := by
    dsimp only [e]
    rw [canonBlankLift C.tm cb]
    exact silent
  have ec (u : ℕ) (hu : u < t) (bit : Bool) :
      (A.runFrom start u).state ≠ some (cx bit) := by
    rw [canonBlankLift C.tm cb]
    exact cuts u hu bit
  have budget (s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ b * (x.length + 1) ^ b) :
      t + 1 + s + 2 ≤ degree * (x.length + 1) ^ degree := by
    have power : (x.length + 1) ^ b ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ degree :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by dsimp [degree]; omega)
    have linear : x.length + 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ degree := by
      simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 1 ≤ x.length + 1 by omega)
        (show 1 ≤ degree by dsimp [degree]; omega)
    have positive : 1 ≤ (x.length + 1) ^ degree := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have bt := bound.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left a linear)
    have bs := hs.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b power)
    dsimp [degree] at *
    nlinarith
  cases v with
  | false =>
    have run : P.runFrom (start.mapState Sum.inl) t = e.mapState Sum.inl :=
      seamCompTM_runFrom_left A (cx true) B ge (fun u hu => ec u hu true) t le_rfl
    have ps : (P.runFrom (start.mapState Sum.inl) t).state = some (ports none) := by
      rw [run]
      simp [Cfg.mapState, es, ports]
    have po : (P.runFrom (start.mapState Sum.inl) t).output = [] := by rw [run]; exact eo
    have pc (u : ℕ) (hu : u < t) (q : Option Bool) :
        (P.runFrom (start.mapState Sum.inl) u).state ≠ some (ports q) := by
      rw [seamCompTM_runFrom_left A (cx true) B ge (fun z hz => ec z hz true) u hu.le]
      cases q with
      | none => simpa [ports, Cfg.mapState] using ec u hu false
      | some bit => simp [ports, Cfg.mapState]
    have computed := emit x t none ps po pc
    refine ⟨false, computed.mono ?_, fun _ => rejected rfl, by simp⟩
    exact (by omega : t + 2 ≤ t + 1 + 0 + 2).trans (budget 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨bits, rest, pair, canonical, guard, position, frame⟩ := ready rfl
    let g : Cfg m Bool S x :=
      ⟨some ge, e.inputPos, fun j => e.workTapes (gb j),
        fun j => e.workTapePos (gb j), []⟩
    have native : g.inputPos.val = 2 * bits.length + 3 := by
      change e.inputPos.val = _
      dsimp only [e]
      rw [canonBlankLift C.tm cb]
      exact position
    have headerBank : gb header = cb ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [gb, cb]
    have headerWord : g.workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape bits ∧
        g.workTapePos header = 0 := by
      change e.workTapes (gb header) = _ ∧ e.workTapePos (gb header) = 0
      dsimp only [e]
      rw [headerBank, canonBlankLift C.tm cb,
        embedEmitCfg_selected_tape, embedEmitCfg_selected_pos]
      simpa [canonReadyWords] using frame ⟨0, by omega⟩ (by simp)
    have fresh (j : Fin m) (hj : j ≠ header) :
        g.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ g.workTapePos j = 0 := by
      have outside : gb j ∉ Set.range cb := by
        rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        have values := congrArg Fin.val hi
        have ilt := i.isLt
        have gv : (gb j).val = C.k + j.val := by simp [gb, hj]
        rw [gv] at values
        change i.val = C.k + j.val at values
        omega
      have fixed := (embedEmitTM_frame cb C.tm (fun _ => FinTM.bufferTape [])
        (fun _ => 0) [] (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) ce (fun _ => [])) t).1 (gb j) outside
      rw [canonEmbedWords C.tm cb ce (fun _ => []) (fun _ => []) (fun _ => [])
        (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl)] at fixed
      exact fixed
    have startG : embedEmitCfg gb e.workTapes e.workTapePos [] g =
        e.mapState (fun _ => ge) := by
      apply canonEmbedEq G gb g (e.mapState (fun _ => ge)) _ _
        (by simp [g, Cfg.mapState, es]) rfl eo.symm
      · exact fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact fun _ _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have lift (u : ℕ) : B.runFrom (e.mapState (fun _ => ge)) u =
        embedEmitCfg gb e.workTapes e.workTapePos [] (G.runFrom g u) := by
      rw [← startG]
      exact embedEmitTM_runFrom gb G _ _ _ _ u
    obtain ⟨s, sb, gs, go, gc⟩ := grammar x bits rest pair canonical guard g rfl rfl
      native headerWord.1 headerWord.2 fresh
    let bit := (canonGrammar F.k (codeBitsNat bits) rest).isSome
    let h := B.runFrom (e.mapState (fun _ => ge)) s
    have hs : h.state = some (gx bit) := by dsimp only [h]; rw [lift]; exact gs
    have ho : h.output = [] := by dsimp only [h]; rw [lift]; exact go
    have hc (u : ℕ) (hu : u < s) (bit : Bool) :
        (B.runFrom (e.mapState (fun _ => ge)) u).state ≠ some (gx bit) := by
      rw [lift]
      exact gc u hu bit
    have whole := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg A (cx true) B ge (rfl : A.runFrom start t = e)
      es (fun u hu => ec u hu true) (rfl : B.runFrom (e.mapState (fun _ => ge)) s = h)
    have ps : (P.runFrom (start.mapState Sum.inl) (t + 1 + s)).state =
        some (ports (some bit)) := by
      rw [whole]
      change (h.mapState Sum.inr).state = _
      simp [Cfg.mapState, hs, ports]
    have po : (P.runFrom (start.mapState Sum.inl) (t + 1 + s)).output = [] := by
      rw [whole]; exact ho
    have pc (u : ℕ) (hu : u < t + 1 + s) (q : Option Bool) :
        (P.runFrom (start.mapState Sum.inl) u).state ≠ some (ports q) := by
      apply canonSeam_avoids A (cx true) B ge (ports q) rfl es
        (fun z hz => ec z hz true) (v := s) ?_ ?_ u hu
      · intro z hz
        cases q with
        | some bit => simp [ports, Cfg.mapState]
        | none =>
          have avoid : (A.runFrom start z).state ≠ some (cx false) := by
            by_cases early : z < t
            · exact ec z early false
            · have eq : z = t := by omega
              rw [eq]
              change e.state ≠ _
              rw [es]
              exact fun eq => by cases cinj (Option.some.inj eq)
          simpa [ports, Cfg.mapState] using avoid
      · intro z hz
        cases q with
        | none => simp [ports, Cfg.mapState]
        | some bit => simpa [ports, Cfg.mapState] using hc z hz bit
    have computed := emit x (t + 1 + s) (some bit) ps po pc
    have law := canonGrammar_verdict F x bits rest pair canonical guard
    refine ⟨bit, ?_, law.1, law.2⟩
    have output : decide (some bit = some true) = bit := by cases bit <;> rfl
    rw [output] at computed
    exact computed.mono (budget s sb)

/-- **A polynomial-time canonizer**: one finite
binary machine computes the fixed serialization of the decoded machine within
`d · (|α| + 1)^d` steps. [AB09, §1.4; the P3.2 round-2 construction]

**Proof sketch.** Implement `F.scan` and emit `F.canonical`
(`Turing.CodeFormat.canonical_eq`). Copy `α` to a work tape. Parse the doubled
state count (`pairDecode`) and check that it is canonical. Check the guard
`F.guard · (n + 1) ≤ |rest|` in binary **before** any state-indexed work: count
`rest` in blocks of `F.guard` cells against a decrementing copy of `bits n`
(`Turing.decrementTM`, `Turing.counterLoopTM`), never expanding `n` in unary.
Then skip the unary initial state with its range check, and the table by the
fixed grammar (`F.skipTable_eq`, `Turing.codeSkipTableK`): `n + 1` rounds of
`3^(k+1)` records, each field by a finite-state check and each successor field
by a binary range check. After the guard every round consumes at least
`4k + 5` cells (`Turing.codeActionK_length`), so there are at most `|α|` rounds.
**The guard may be `0`** (wave-1 statement gate, round 1, finding 5). `F.guard` is
unconstrained, and a zero guard bounds nothing, so the guard check alone does not bound
`n`. Add the grammar-derived necessary check: a successful parse consumes at least
`(4k + 5) · 3^(k+1) · (n + 1)` table bits, a positive multiple of `n + 1`. Run it in binary
against a decrementing copy of `bits n`, failing fast once the suffix is exhausted. Early
rejection by this check or by the guard yields exactly the prescribed fallback, because
`F.scan` fails on the same inputs (`Turing.CodeFormat.canonical_eq`). No stronger
`MachineFormat` hypothesis is needed.
Check the all-`true` suffix. On success copy the consumed prefix to the output;
on failure emit the constant `F.serialize F.fallback`. Every phase is polynomial
in `|α|`; take `d` at least the coefficient and the exponent.

**Implementation.** Validation and emission are separate phases. A validator
(`exists_canonDecider`) decides whether `F.scan` succeeds, in polynomial time and with a
single verdict bit, by the two-port parse front end (header validity and canonicality, and the
positive guard `max F.guard ((4k + 5) · 3^(k+1))` checked in binary against the successor of
the header) followed by the grammar stage (`exists_canonGrammarStage`). On acceptance the strip
machine (`exists_canonStripTM`) erases the input's maximal trailing `true` suffix, which leaves
the decoded machine's serialization (`canonStrip_of_scan`); on rejection the constant
`F.serialize F.fallback` is emitted; `Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond` composes the three.
The record validator has an entry and two distinct verdict ports, while a public counter loop's
body must return to its own anchor on success; so every record round is wrapped by a fresh-anchor
return adapter (`canonReturnAdapter`), which makes it a positive first-return-or-escape round,
before it becomes the loop's body. -/
theorem exists_polyCanonizer :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (d : ℕ),
      C.ComputesFunInTime (fun α => F.serialize (F.decode α)) fun n => d * (n + 1) ^ d := by
  obtain ⟨D, a, decider⟩ := exists_canonDecider F
  choose verdict spec using decider
  obtain ⟨M, b, strip⟩ := exists_canonStripTM
  obtain ⟨E, e, fallback⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_const (F.serialize F.fallback)
  have decides : D.ComputesFunInTime (fun α => [verdict α]) fun n => a * (n + 1) ^ a :=
    fun α => (spec α).1
  obtain ⟨C, c, branch⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_cond decides strip fallback
  refine ⟨C, c * (a + b + e + 1) + a + b + 1, ?_⟩
  intro α
  have output : (if verdict α then canonStrip α else F.serialize F.fallback) =
      F.serialize (F.decode α) := by
    cases hv : verdict α with
    | false =>
      rw [(spec α).2.1 hv]
      rfl
    | true =>
      obtain ⟨tail, hs⟩ := (spec α).2.2 hv
      exact canonStrip_of_scan F α tail hs
  have run := branch α
  dsimp only at run ⊢
  rw [output] at run
  apply run.mono
  set d := c * (a + b + e + 1) + a + b + 1
  set P := (α.length + 1) ^ d
  have base : 1 ≤ α.length + 1 := by omega
  have pa : (α.length + 1) ^ a ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right base (by omega)
  have pb : (α.length + 1) ^ b ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right base (by omega)
  have p1 : α.length + 1 ≤ P := by
    simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right base (show 1 ≤ d by omega)
  have p0 : 1 ≤ P := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have inner : a * (α.length + 1) ^ a +
      max (b * (α.length + 1) ^ b) (e * (α.length + 1)) + 1 ≤ (a + b + e + 1) * P := by
    have ha := Nat.mul_le_mul_left a pa
    have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b pb
    have he := Nat.mul_le_mul_left e p1
    have hm : max (b * (α.length + 1) ^ b) (e * (α.length + 1)) ≤ b * P + e * P :=
      max_le (by omega) (by omega)
    nlinarith
  calc
    c * (a * (α.length + 1) ^ a + max (b * (α.length + 1) ^ b) (e * (α.length + 1)) + 1)
        ≤ c * ((a + b + e + 1) * P) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c inner
    _ = (c * (a + b + e + 1)) * P := by ring
    _ ≤ d * P := Nat.mul_le_mul_right P (by omega)

/-! ### Finite output summary (D4 move, generalized from Codes2Tape)

The four clock declarations below, with the five output-summary declarations now
in `Build/StepBlock` (`Turing.StepBlock.outputSummary` and its lemmas, H2-M),
replace their specialized ZF-B3 counterparts. This is the semantic specification
of the step block, not a finite-machine interpreter or a claim about its running
time.
-/

section StepBlockClients

open StepBlock

/-- Semantic clock for any finite-tape binary machine. It performs exactly the
permitted number of source steps, maintaining only the finite output summary,
and then inspects halting and exact output. This is a specification function,
not a finite-machine construction or a claim about machine time. -/
private def summaryClock {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
    {x : List Bool} : ℕ → Cfg k Bool Q x → Option Bool → Bool
  | 0, c, s => c.state.isNone && (s == some true)
  | t + 1, c, s =>
    summaryClock M t (M.step c) (summaryEmit s (M.outputSymbol c))

/-- The clock's final inspection includes the last permitted transition.
Halted configurations are allowed, so the equation also covers padding an
early halt to the deadline.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the deadline. The output-summary update is
exactly append by the step's optional emission; cite the public run and
output-step equations to identify the residual run. -/
private lemma summaryClock_correct {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q)
    {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool Q x) (t : ℕ) :
    summaryClock M t c (outputSummary c.output) =
      ((M.runFrom c t).state.isNone &&
        (outputSummary (M.runFrom c t).output == some true)) := by
  induction t generalizing c <;>
    simp only [summaryClock, ← outputSummary_append, ← MultiTapeTM.step_output,
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step, *]

/-- Inspecting the semantic clock at the deadline is exactly bounded acceptance,
including a halt on the last permitted transition. -/
private lemma summaryClock_accepts (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ) :
    summaryClock M.tm t (M.tm.initCfg x) none = true ↔ M.ComputesInTime x [true] t := by
  change summaryClock M.tm t (M.tm.initCfg x)
    (outputSummary (M.tm.initCfg x).output) = true ↔ _
  rw [summaryClock_correct, FinTM.computesInTime_iff]
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none, beq_iff_eq, outputSummary_true]

/-- The zero-deadline clock rejects every initialized machine. -/
private lemma summaryClock_zero (M : FinTM Bool) (x : List Bool) :
    summaryClock M.tm 0 (M.tm.initCfg x) none = false := rfl

/-- The hosted clock `StepBlock.hostedLoopTM` with its two live exits replaced by the
one-step verdict. Timeout emits false; simulated halt tests the restored summary
cell. Every other transition is the existing hosted clock transition. -/
private def h1HostedVerdictTM (k : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) Bool (CounterLoopState (Σ key, Ph k key) × Bool) :=
  { hostedLoopTM k with tr := fun q inp work =>
      if q.1 = .done ∨ q.1 = .escape then
        ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0),
          some (if q.1 = .escape then
            work (vhostBank (summaryTape k).castSucc) == some true else false), none⟩
      else (hostedLoopTM k).tr q inp work }

/-- The physical hosted clock and its verdict, from the prepared round
seam. The endpoint is halted and emits precisely the inherited semantic
clock's answer, after the arbitrary prior physical output prefix.

**Proof sketch.** The public agreement theorem transports the hosted clock
run because its strict prefixes avoid both verdict exits. At the endpoint,
the representation places the output summary under its head. One stationary
halting step reads it. The frozen semantic clock equation identifies this
bit; neither the physical run nor the acceptance argument is re-proved. -/
private theorem h1HostedVerdict_effect {k n : ℕ} {x z : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (n + 1)))
    (d : Cfg (k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit k true))
    (rel : Rep M.tr (M.initCfg x) d) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK M.tr).length + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3,
      let e := (h1HostedVerdictTM k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T
      e.state = none ∧ e.inputPos = p ∧
        e.output = d.output ++ [summaryClock M t (M.initCfg x) none] := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, ct, b, bound, -, related, output, -, _, run, cut⟩ :=
    hostedLoopTM_run M (M.initCfg x) (by simp [MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]) d entry rel
      t.bits (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0 (by intro p _ _; simp) t (counterValue_bits t) true
      (by simp [FinTM.VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]) p []
  let start := vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
    (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []
  have agree : (hostedLoopTM k).AgreeOn (h1HostedVerdictTM k)
      {q | q.1 ≠ .done ∧ q.1 ≠ .escape} := by
    intro q hq inp work
    simp only [h1HostedVerdictTM, hq.1, hq.2, or_self, ↓reduceIte]
  have transfer := MultiTapeTM.runFrom_eq_of_agreeOn agree start T (by
    intro u hu q hq
    constructor
    · intro bad
      exact (cut u hu q.2).1 (hq.trans (congrArg some (Prod.ext bad rfl)))
    · intro bad
      exact (cut u hu q.2).2 (hq.trans (congrArg some (Prod.ext bad rfl))))
  have semantic : summaryClock M t (M.initCfg x) none =
      ((M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state.isNone &&
        (outputSummary (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).output == some true)) :=
    summaryClock_correct M (M.initCfg x) t
  obtain ⟨hs, -, -, cell⟩ := hostedLoop_read M.tr (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t) e related
    (if (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state.isSome then .done else .escape) ct 0 b p []
  refine ⟨T + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
  change ((h1HostedVerdictTM k).runFrom start (T + 1)).state = none ∧ _
  rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', transfer, run, semantic]
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  rw [hs]
  simp only [h1HostedVerdictTM, cell]
  cases state : (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state <;>
    simp [Action.apply, vhostCfg, counter_cfg_eq, output, moveInputPos_zero]

/-- The hosted verdict's bit is bounded acceptance, by the inherited
semantic bridge. This specializes only the prepared-seam contract: parsing
and canonizer installation are separate startup obligations. -/
private theorem h1HostedVerdict_accepts (F : MachineFormat) (α x z : List Bool)
    (d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, Ph F.k key) x)
    (entry : d.state = some (exit F.k true))
    (rel : Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
      ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg x) d) (t : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).state = none ∧
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).output = d.output ++ [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t) := by
  obtain ⟨T, bound, halted, _, output⟩ :=
    h1HostedVerdict_effect (F.machine (F.decode α)) d entry rel t p
  exact ⟨T, bound, _, halted, output, summaryClock_accepts (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)) x t⟩

/-- **The installation is uniform and polynomial.** One install module, uniform in the code,
which from the code `α` returns with the serialization of the decoded machine installed, at a
first positive return within `a · ((|α| + 1)^d + |α| + max |α| |F.serialize F.fallback| + 1)`.

**Proof sketch.** The format's polynomial canonizer through the public install call; the
canonical word's length is at most `max |α| |F.serialize F.fallback|`, and `F.serialize_eq`
names the installed word. -/
private theorem us_install :
    ∃ (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) (a d : ℕ), 0 < C.k ∧
      ∀ x α : List Bool, ∃ t ≤ a * ((α.length + 1) ^ d + α.length +
          max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 1), 0 < t ∧
        (∀ t', 0 < t' → t' < t →
          (C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k α)) t').state ≠
            some exit) ∧
        C.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) entry (stateWord C.k α)) t =
          Cfg.ofWords exit (stateWord C.k (serializeK (F.machine (F.decode α)))) := by
  obtain ⟨P, d, hP⟩ := F.exists_polyCanonizer
  obtain ⟨C, entry, exit, c, hk, inst⟩ := FinTM.exists_installCallTM P _ _ hP
  refine ⟨C, entry, exit, c * (d + 1), d, hk, fun x α => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hpos, hcut, hrun⟩ := inst x α
  have hlen := F.serialize_decode_length_le α
  refine ⟨t, ht.trans ?_, hpos, hcut, ?_⟩
  · have hm : d * (α.length + 1) ^ d ≤ (d + 1) * (α.length + 1) ^ d :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ d)
    calc c * (d * (α.length + 1) ^ d + α.length + (F.serialize (F.decode α)).length + 1)
        ≤ c * ((d + 1) * (α.length + 1) ^ d + α.length +
            max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 1) := by
          apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left; omega
      _ ≤ c * ((d + 1) * ((α.length + 1) ^ d + α.length +
            max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 1)) := by
          apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
          nlinarith [Nat.zero_le ((α.length + 1) ^ d)]
      _ = c * (d + 1) * ((α.length + 1) ^ d + α.length +
            max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 1) := by ring
  · rw [hrun, F.serialize_eq]

/-- **Deterministic input locality.** In `t` steps a machine reads at most the first `t` input
symbols, so its runs on `x.take t` and on `x` agree in state and output at time `t`. -/
private theorem us_locality {k : ℕ} {Q : Type} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool Q) (x : List Bool)
    (t : ℕ) :
    (M.runFrom (M.initCfg (x.take t)) t).state = (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).state ∧
      (M.runFrom (M.initCfg (x.take t)) t).output = (M.runFrom (M.initCfg x) t).output := by
  have h := NDTM.runWith_initCfg_take M.toNDTM x t (List.replicate t false)
    (by rw [List.length_replicate])
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_runWith, MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_initCfg,
    List.length_replicate] at h
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.2.2.2⟩

/-- **A halt with a one-bit output gives both clauses.** If a machine halts at `T ≤ B` with
output `[answer]`, and `answer` decides `P`, it computes `[true]` within `B` when `P` holds and
`[false]` within `B` otherwise. -/
private theorem us_verdict (S : FinTM Bool) (z : List Bool) (T B : ℕ) (answer : Bool) (P : Prop)
    (hT : T ≤ B) (halt : (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg z) T).state = none)
    (out : (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg z) T).output = [answer]) (hans : answer = true ↔ P) :
    (P → S.ComputesInTime z [true] B) ∧ (¬P → S.ComputesInTime z [false] B) := by
  have hc : S.ComputesInTime z [answer] T := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨halt, out⟩
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rw [hans.mpr hp] at hc
    exact hc.mono hT
  · intro hp
    cases answer with
    | false => exact hc.mono hT
    | true => exact absurd (hans.mp rfl) hp

/-- The installed table is no longer than the code or the format's fallback serialization. -/
private theorem us_table_le (α : List Bool) :
    (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length ≤
      max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length := by
  have h := F.serialize_decode_length_le α
  rw [F.serialize_eq, serializeK_eq, length_pairEncode, List.length_append] at h
  omega

/-- **The verdict on the window decides acceptance on the input.** The hosted verdict, run from
a represented start on the window `x.take t`, halts within its bound with one output bit, which
is `true` exactly when the decoded machine accepts `x` itself within `t` steps. -/
private theorem us_window_verdict (α x z : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) (x.take t))
    (entry : d.state = some (StepBlock.exit F.k true))
    (rel : StepBlock.Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
      ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg (x.take t)) d)
    (p : Fin (z.length + 2)) (silent : d.output = []) :
    ∃ T ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).state = none ∧
      ((h1HostedVerdictTM F.k).runFrom
        (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d
          (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true p []) T).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t) := by
  obtain ⟨T, bound, answer, halted, out, iff⟩ :=
    h1HostedVerdict_accepts F α (x.take t) z d entry rel t p
  refine ⟨T, bound, answer, halted, by rw [out, silent, List.nil_append], iff.trans ?_⟩
  rw [FinTM.computesInTime_iff, FinTM.computesInTime_iff]
  obtain ⟨hs, ho⟩ := us_locality (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).tm x t
  rw [hs, ho]

/-- **The joint ledger.** With `N = |α| + |x| + t + 1`, a startup within the polynomial
installer's cost plus its linear terms, one dispatch step and the hosted verdict's quadratic
bound together stay within `D · N^D`, for `D` built from the constants alone.

**Proof sketch.** Every term is at most a constant times `P = N^(d₀ + 2)`: the installer's
power because `|α| + 1 ≤ N`, the linear terms because `N ≤ P`, the verdict's `t · |table|`
because `N · N ≤ P`, and the constants because `1 ≤ P`. Collect the coefficients, then use
`P ≤ N^D` for `d₀ + 2 ≤ D`. -/
private theorem us_ledger (a d₀ A B L αl xl t T₁ T₂ s m tb bl : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ αl + L) (hs : s ≤ m) (htb : tb ≤ m) (hbl : bl ≤ t)
    (hT₁ : T₁ ≤ a * ((αl + 1) ^ d₀ + αl + m + 1) + A * (αl + s + 1) +
      B * (bl + min t xl + 1))
    (hT₂ : T₂ ≤ t * (50 * (tb + 1)) + 4 * t + 2 * bl + 3) :
    T₁ + 1 + T₂ ≤ (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110 + d₀ + 2) *
      (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110 + d₀ + 2) := by
  have hN : 1 ≤ αl + xl + t + 1 := by omega
  have hP1 : 1 ≤ (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hN
  have hNP : αl + xl + t + 1 ≤ (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := by
    calc αl + xl + t + 1 = (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (by omega)
  have hNNP : (αl + xl + t + 1) * (αl + xl + t + 1) ≤ (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := by
    rw [← pow_two]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (by omega)
  have hαP : (αl + 1) ^ d₀ ≤ (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) :=
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) d₀).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (by omega))
  have hLP : L ≤ L * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hP1
  have hLN : L * (αl + xl + t + 1) ≤ L * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left L hNP
  have hX : (αl + 1) ^ d₀ + αl + m + 1 ≤ (L + 4) * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := by
    rw [add_mul]; omega
  have hY : αl + s + 1 ≤ (L + 3) * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := by
    rw [add_mul]; omega
  have hZ : bl + min t xl + 1 ≤ 3 * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := by omega
  have hW : t * (50 * (tb + 1)) ≤
      (αl + xl + t + 1) * (50 * ((αl + xl + t + 1) + L + 1)) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  have hW' : (αl + xl + t + 1) * (50 * ((αl + xl + t + 1) + L + 1)) =
      50 * ((αl + xl + t + 1) * (αl + xl + t + 1)) + 50 * (L * (αl + xl + t + 1)) +
        50 * (αl + xl + t + 1) := by ring
  have hc : T₁ + 1 + T₂ ≤ (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110) *
      (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := by
    have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left a hX
    have h2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left A hY
    have h3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left B hZ
    have e : (a * (L + 4) + A * (L + 3) + 3 * B + 50 * L + 110) *
        (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) =
        a * ((L + 4) * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2)) +
          A * ((L + 3) * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2)) +
          B * (3 * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2)) +
          50 * (L * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2)) + 110 * (αl + xl + t + 1) ^ (d₀ + 2) := by
      ring
    rw [e]
    omega
  refine hc.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (by omega)))

/-- **The hosted verdict's tape map into the startup's tapes.** The virtual window first, then
the `k` mirrored work tapes on the reserved passive tapes, the table, the summary, and last the
counter. The map is injective by the startup's ten separation facts.

**Proof sketch.** Define the map by `Fin.addCases` and `Fin.lastCases`, which gives the five
value equations. Every index of `Fin (1 + (k + 2 + 1))` is one of the five forms, by its value.
For injectivity, compare two indices form by form. Two reserved tapes are equal only at the same
index, since `ιP` is injective. Any other two distinct forms land on tapes that the separation
facts keep apart. -/
private theorem us_bank {k K : ℕ} (ιP : Fin k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (hcw : jctr ≠ jwin) (hct : jctr ≠ jtbl) (hcs : jctr ≠ jsm) (hwt : jwin ≠ jtbl)
    (hws : jwin ≠ jsm) (hts : jtbl ≠ jsm) (hcP : jctr ∉ Set.range ιP)
    (hwP : jwin ∉ Set.range ιP) (htP : jtbl ∉ Set.range ιP) (hsP : jsm ∉ Set.range ιP) :
    ∃ g : Fin (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K,
      g (Fin.castAdd (k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin ∧
      (∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i) ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 0))) = jtbl ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 1))) = jsm ∧
      g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (k + 2))) = jctr := by
  obtain ⟨f, fw, fP, ft, fs, fc⟩ : ∃ f : Fin (1 + (k + 2 + 1)) → Fin K,
      f (Fin.castAdd (k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin ∧
      (∀ i, f (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i) ∧
      f (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 0))) = jtbl ∧
      f (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 1))) = jsm ∧
      f (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (k + 2))) = jctr :=
    ⟨Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => Fin K) (fun _ => jwin)
        (Fin.lastCases (motive := fun _ => Fin K) jctr
          (Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => Fin K) (fun i => ιP i)
            (fun j => if j = 0 then jtbl else jsm))),
      by rw [Fin.addCases_left],
      fun i => by rw [Fin.addCases_right, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.addCases_left],
      by
        rw [Fin.addCases_right, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.addCases_right]
        try exact if_pos rfl,
      by
        rw [Fin.addCases_right, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.addCases_right]
        try exact if_neg (by decide),
      by rw [Fin.addCases_right, Fin.lastCases_last]⟩
  have cover : ∀ a : Fin (1 + (k + 2 + 1)), a = Fin.castAdd (k + 2 + 1) 0 ∨
      (∃ i, a = Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) ∨
      a = Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 0)) ∨
      a = Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd k 1)) ∨
      a = Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (k + 2)) := by
    intro a
    have ha := a.isLt
    by_cases h0 : a.val = 0
    · left
      exact Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.coe_castAdd, Fin.val_zero]; omega)
    by_cases h1 : a.val ≤ k
    · right; left
      refine ⟨⟨a.val - 1, by omega⟩, Fin.ext ?_⟩
      rw [Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc, Fin.coe_castAdd]
      show (a : ℕ) = 1 + (a.val - 1)
      omega
    by_cases h2 : a.val = k + 1
    · right; right; left
      exact Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.val_zero]; omega)
    by_cases h3 : a.val = k + 2
    · right; right; right; left
      exact Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.coe_castSucc, Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.val_one]; omega)
    · right; right; right; right
      exact Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.val_last]; omega)
  refine ⟨⟨f, fun a b h => ?_⟩, fw, fP, ft, fs, fc⟩
  rcases cover a with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩ | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases cover b with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩ | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    simp only [fw, fP, ft, fs, fc] at h <;>
    first
    | rfl
    | exact congrArg (fun i => Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) (ιP.injective h)
    | exact absurd h hcw | exact absurd h.symm hcw
    | exact absurd h hct | exact absurd h.symm hct
    | exact absurd h hcs | exact absurd h.symm hcs
    | exact absurd h hwt | exact absurd h.symm hwt
    | exact absurd h hws | exact absurd h.symm hws
    | exact absurd h hts | exact absurd h.symm hts
    | exact (hcP ⟨_, h⟩).elim | exact (hcP ⟨_, h.symm⟩).elim
    | exact (hwP ⟨_, h⟩).elim | exact (hwP ⟨_, h.symm⟩).elim
    | exact (htP ⟨_, h⟩).elim | exact (htP ⟨_, h.symm⟩).elim
    | exact (hsP ⟨_, h⟩).elim | exact (hsP ⟨_, h.symm⟩).elim

/-- **The loop junction.** A configuration with the interpreter startup's threshold fields, at
`p = F.k`, is the hosted verdict's start embedded along the tape map. The startup's threshold has
the counter `bits t`, the window `x.take t`, the decoded machine's table and its summary on the
four role tapes, the `F.k` reserved tapes blank, every role and reserved head at `0`, and the
empty output. Relabelled to the hosted clock's first state, it is the forwarding embedding of
`vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (.dec .run)) d (bufferTape t.bits) 0)` at the configuration's own
input head. Here `d` is a represented start of the decoded machine on the window, at the step
block's live exit, with empty output.

**Proof sketch.** Take for `d` the step block's live exit, input head `1`, the mirrored tapes
blank, the table and the summary from the startup, every head at `0`, empty output. It
represents the initial configuration on the window (`StepBlock.Rep_iff`, the `Cfg.init`
fields). For the embedding, apply `embedEmitCfg_eq`. The state, input head and output come from
the field equations of `vhostCfg`, `counter_cfg_eq` and `Cfg.mapState`. For a selected tape,
split its index by `Fin.addCases` and `Fin.lastCases` into the window, the mirrored bank, the
table, the summary and the counter; each contents and head is the corresponding threshold field.
The tapes off the map are the configuration's own. -/
private theorem us_junction {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} {z : List Bool} (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K) (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c : Cfg K Bool Q z) (done : Q) (hst : c.state = some done) (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    ∃ d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) (x.take t),
      d.state = some (StepBlock.exit F.k true) ∧
      StepBlock.Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
        ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg (x.take t)) d ∧
      d.output = [] ∧
      c.mapState (fun _ => ((CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) :
          CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool)) =
        embedEmitCfg g c.workTapes c.workTapePos []
          (vhostCfg (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
            (FinTM.bufferTape t.bits) 0) true c.inputPos []) := by
  obtain ⟨wt, wtP, wtT, wtS⟩ : ∃ wt : Fin (F.k + 2) → ℤ → Option Bool,
      (∀ i, wt (Fin.castAdd 2 i) = fun _ => none) ∧
      wt (Fin.natAdd F.k 0) = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr) ∧
      wt (Fin.natAdd F.k 1) =
        StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀) :=
    ⟨Fin.addCases (motive := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) (fun _ => fun _ => none)
        (fun j => if j = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr)
          else StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀)),
      fun i => by rw [Fin.addCases_left],
      by
        rw [Fin.addCases_right]
        try exact if_pos rfl,
      by
        rw [Fin.addCases_right]
        try exact if_neg (by decide)⟩
  obtain ⟨d, hds, hdi, hdw, hdp, hdo⟩ :
      ∃ d : Cfg (F.k + 2) Bool (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) (x.take t),
        d.state = some (StepBlock.exit F.k true) ∧ d.inputPos = 1 ∧ d.workTapes = wt ∧
          d.workTapePos = (fun _ => 0) ∧ d.output = [] :=
    ⟨⟨some (StepBlock.exit F.k true), 1, wt, fun _ => 0, []⟩, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hrep : StepBlock.Rep (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr
      ((F.machine (F.decode α)).initCfg (x.take t)) d := by
    rw [StepBlock.Rep_iff, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos, Cfg.init_output,
      Cfg.init_state, StepBlock.outputSummary_nil, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some,
      StepBlock.tableTape_eq, StepBlock.summaryTape_eq, hdi, hdw, hdp]
    refine ⟨rfl, fun i => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, wtT, wtS, rfl, rfl⟩
    · rw [wtP i]
      funext q
      rw [Cfg.init_workTapes]
    · rw [Cfg.init_workTapePos]
  have hcl_tapes : ∀ i : Fin (F.k + 2 + 1),
      (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
        (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) 0).workTapes i =
      Fin.lastCases (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) d.workTapes i := by
    intro i
    rw [counter_cfg_eq]
  have hcl_pos : ∀ i : Fin (F.k + 2 + 1),
      (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
        (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) 0).workTapePos i =
      Fin.lastCases 0 d.workTapePos i := by
    intro i
    rw [counter_cfg_eq]
  have hcl_in : (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
      (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) 0).inputPos = d.inputPos := by
    rw [counter_cfg_eq]
  have hcl_out : (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
      (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) 0).output = d.output := by
    rw [counter_cfg_eq]
  have hcl_state : (counterLoopCfg (some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run)) d
      (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) 0).state =
      some (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run) := by
    rw [counter_cfg_eq]
  refine ⟨d, hds, hrep, hdo, ?_⟩
  refine (embedEmitCfg_eq g c.workTapes c.workTapePos [] _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
  · rw [vhostCfg_state, hcl_state, Cfg.mapState_state, hst, Option.map_some, Option.map_some]
  · rw [vhostCfg_inputPos, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · rw [vhostCfg_output, hcl_out, hdo, Cfg.mapState_output, hout, List.nil_append,
      List.nil_append]
  · intro i
    induction i using Fin.addCases with
    | left i0 =>
      obtain rfl : i0 = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      refine ⟨funext fun q => ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [vhostCfg_workTapes, Fin.addCases_left, Cfg.mapState_workTapes, gw, hwin]
      · rw [vhostCfg_workTapePos, Fin.addCases_left, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, gw, hwinp, hcl_in,
          hdi, Fin.val_one]
        norm_num
    | right j =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        refine ⟨funext fun q => ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [vhostCfg_workTapes, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_tapes, Fin.lastCases_last,
            Cfg.mapState_workTapes, gc, hctr]
        · rw [vhostCfg_workTapePos, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_pos, Fin.lastCases_last,
            Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, gc, hctrp]
      | cast j =>
        induction j using Fin.addCases with
        | left i =>
          refine ⟨funext fun q => ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [vhostCfg_workTapes, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_tapes, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, hdw,
              wtP, Cfg.mapState_workTapes, gP, (hpas i).1]
          · rw [vhostCfg_workTapePos, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_pos, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, hdp,
              Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, gP, (hpas i).2]
        | right j =>
          rcases (Fin.exists_fin_two (p := fun i => i = j)).mp ⟨j, rfl⟩ with rfl | rfl
          · refine ⟨funext fun q => ?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [vhostCfg_workTapes, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_tapes, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, hdw,
                wtT, Cfg.mapState_workTapes, gt, htbl]
            · rw [vhostCfg_workTapePos, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_pos, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, hdp,
                Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, gt, htblp]
          · refine ⟨funext fun q => ?_, ?_⟩
            · rw [vhostCfg_workTapes, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_tapes, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, hdw,
                wtS, Cfg.mapState_workTapes, gs, hsm]
            · rw [vhostCfg_workTapePos, Fin.addCases_right, hcl_pos, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, hdp,
                Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, gs, hsmp]
  · intro j _
    refine ⟨funext fun q => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]

/-- **The startup's threshold into the verdict.** From a run of a machine `U` that first
reaches `done` at a configuration with the startup's threshold fields, the seam into the hosted
verdict embedded along the tape map halts, within the hosted verdict's bound after the threshold
and one dispatch step, with output exactly `[answer]`, where `answer` decides bounded acceptance
of the decoded machine on `x` itself.

**Proof sketch.** The junction gives the relabelled threshold as the embedded hosted start, with
a represented start `d` on the window. The window verdict runs from it and decides acceptance on
`x`. The seam's right run (`seamCompTM_runFrom_right`) and the forwarding transport
(`embedEmitTM_runFrom`) carry that run into the composite. Its state and output are read through
the relabelling's and the transport's field equations, after the threshold's empty output. -/
private theorem us_tail {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} [DecidableEq Q] (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (U : MultiTapeTM K Bool Q) (done : Q) (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K)
    (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c₀ c : Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) (T₁ : ℕ)
    (run : U.runFrom c₀ T₁ = c) (hst : c.state = some done)
    (cut : ∀ u < T₁, (U.runFrom c₀ u).state ≠ some done) (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    ∃ T₂ ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      ((seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true)).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl)
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).state = none ∧
      ((seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true)).runFrom (c₀.mapState Sum.inl)
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t) := by
  obtain ⟨d, hds, hrel, hdo, junc⟩ :=
    us_junction F α x t g ιP jctr jwin jtbl jsm gw gP gt gs gc c done hst hout hctr hctrp hwin
      hwinp htbl htblp hsm hsmp hpas
  obtain ⟨T₂, bound, answer, halted, out, iff⟩ :=
    us_window_verdict F α x _ t d hds hrel c.inputPos hdo
  refine ⟨T₂, bound, answer, ?_⟩
  rw [seamCompTM_runFrom_right U done _ _ run hst cut T₂, junc, embedEmitTM_runFrom]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, iff⟩
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_state, embedEmitCfg_state, halted]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, embedEmitCfg_output, out, List.nil_append]

/-- **The start.** A composite over a sum of states, restarted at the left tag of a state
`entry`, starts at the blank configuration at `entry`, relabelled by the left tag: input head `1`,
every tape blank, every head at `0`, empty output.

**Proof sketch.** The restarted machine's initial configuration is `Cfg.init` at the tagged state
(`initCfg_with_q₀`); compare it with the relabelled blank start field by field, through the
`Cfg.init` and `Cfg.mapState` field equations. -/
private theorem us_start {K : ℕ} {Q R : Type} (W : MultiTapeTM K Bool (Q ⊕ R)) (entry : Q)
    (z : List Bool) :
    ({ W with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } : MultiTapeTM K Bool (Q ⊕ R)).initCfg z =
      (⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ : Cfg K Bool Q z).mapState Sum.inl := by
  rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_with_q₀]
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rw [Cfg.init_state, Cfg.mapState_state]
    rfl
  · rw [Cfg.init_inputPos, Cfg.mapState_inputPos]
  · funext j q
    rw [Cfg.init_workTapes, Cfg.mapState_workTapes]
  · funext j
    rw [Cfg.init_workTapePos, Cfg.mapState_workTapePos]
  · rw [Cfg.init_output, Cfg.mapState_output]

/-- **The simulator's run.** For a machine `U` that, from the blank start at `entry` on
`⟨⟨bits t, α⟩, x⟩`, first reaches `done` at a configuration with the startup's threshold fields,
the binary machine `S` (the seam of `U` into the hosted verdict embedded along the tape map,
restarted at `entry`) halts from its initial configuration within `T₁ + 1 + T₂` steps with
output `[answer]`, deciding bounded acceptance on `x`. This is the shape `us_verdict` takes.

**Proof sketch.** `us_start` turns `S`'s initial configuration into the relabelled blank start,
and the restart changes no run (`runFrom_with_q₀`); then `us_tail`. -/
private theorem us_run {K : ℕ} {Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] (α x : List Bool)
    (t : ℕ) (U : MultiTapeTM K Bool Q) (entry done : Q) (g : Fin (1 + (F.k + 2 + 1)) ↪ Fin K)
    (ιP : Fin F.k ↪ Fin K) (jctr jwin jtbl jsm : Fin K)
    (gw : g (Fin.castAdd (F.k + 2 + 1) 0) = jwin)
    (gP : ∀ i, g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.castAdd 2 i))) = ιP i)
    (gt : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 0))) = jtbl)
    (gs : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.castSucc (Fin.natAdd F.k 1))) = jsm)
    (gc : g (Fin.natAdd 1 (Fin.last (F.k + 2))) = jctr)
    (c : Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) (T₁ : ℕ)
    (run : U.runFrom ⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ T₁ = c)
    (hst : c.state = some done)
    (cut : ∀ u < T₁, (U.runFrom (⟨some entry, 1, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩ :
      Cfg K Bool Q (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x)) u).state ≠ some done)
    (hout : c.output = [])
    (hctr : c.workTapes jctr = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits t)) (hctrp : c.workTapePos jctr = 0)
    (hwin : c.workTapes jwin = FinTM.bufferTape (x.take t)) (hwinp : c.workTapePos jwin = 0)
    (htbl : c.workTapes jtbl = FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr))
    (htblp : c.workTapePos jtbl = 0)
    (hsm : c.workTapes jsm =
      StepBlock.summaryCells none (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀))
    (hsmp : c.workTapePos jsm = 0)
    (hpas : ∀ i, c.workTapes (ιP i) = (fun _ => none) ∧ c.workTapePos (ιP i) = 0) :
    let S : FinTM Bool :=
      { k := K, State := Q ⊕ (CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool),
        tm := { seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
          (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } }
    ∃ T₂ ≤ t * (50 * ((tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr).length + 1)) +
        4 * t + 2 * t.bits.length + 3, ∃ answer : Bool,
      (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x))
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).state = none ∧
      (S.tm.runFrom (S.tm.initCfg (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x))
          (T₁ + 1 + T₂)).output = [answer] ∧
      (answer = true ↔ (F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t) := by
  intro S
  obtain ⟨T₂, bound, answer, halted, out, iff⟩ :=
    us_tail F α x t U done g ιP jctr jwin jtbl jsm gw gP gt gs gc _ c T₁ run hst cut hout hctr
      hctrp hwin hwinp htbl htblp hsm hsmp hpas
  have hS : S.tm = ({ seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
      (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } :
        MultiTapeTM K Bool (Q ⊕ (CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool))) := rfl
  refine ⟨T₂, bound, answer, ?_, ?_, iff⟩
  · rw [hS, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀, us_start]
    exact halted
  · rw [hS, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_with_q₀, us_start]
    exact out

end StepBlockClients

/-- **The uniform bounded-acceptance simulator**: one finite binary machine and one degree such
that, on `⟨⟨bits t, α⟩, x⟩`, the machine answers `[true]` if the machine `α` denotes halts on `x`
with output exactly `[true]` within `t` steps, and `[false]` otherwise, within
`d · (|α| + |x| + t + 1)^d` steps. [AB09, §1.4.1, Theorem 1.9, time-bounded form; Example 3.6(3)'s
uniformity]

**Proof sketch.** Install the decoded machine's serialization by the polynomial canonizer
`Turing.MachineFormat.exists_polyCanonizer` through `Turing.FinTM.exists_installCallTM`; by
`F.serialize_eq` it is `serializeK (F.machine (F.decode α))`, of length at most
`max |α| |F.serialize F.fallback|` (`Turing.CodeFormat.serialize_decode_length_le`). The
interpreter startup `Turing.exists_interpreterStartup`, with `F.k` passive tapes reserved for the
simulated work tapes, reads the nested input and leaves the deadline word `bits t` on a counter,
the window `x.take t` on a buffer, and the table and the initial-state summary on two more tapes.
From there the step block's hosted clock and verdict run the decoded machine on the window for
`t` steps and emit one bit, `true` exactly when it halts with output `[true]` within `t`
(`h1HostedVerdict_accepts`); deterministic input locality makes acceptance on the window
acceptance on `x`. The ledger: the installer's polynomial, the startup's terms linear in `|α|`,
the serialization, `|bits t|` and `min t |x|`, and `t` rounds of at most `50 · (|table| + 1)`
steps with the counter's `4t + 2|bits t| + 3`, all at most `d · (|α| + |x| + t + 1)^d` for one
`d` depending only on the format.

**Implementation.** `S` is the startup seamed (`Turing.seamCompTM`) to the hosted verdict,
which runs embedded (`Turing.embedEmitTM`) along a tape map from the startup's roles: the window,
the reserved tapes as the mirrored work tapes, the table, the summary and the counter. `S` is
restarted at the startup's entry state, so its initial configuration is the startup's blank
start. The startup's threshold, relabelled to the clock's first state, is the hosted verdict's
start, with a represented initial configuration on the window; it is read through the field
equations of the virtual-input host, the counter loop and the forwarding embedding. The startup
is silent, so the verdict's bit is the only output.
-/
theorem exists_uniformSimulator :
    ∃ (S : FinTM Bool) (d : ℕ), ∀ (α x : List Bool) (t : ℕ),
      ((F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t →
        S.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [true]
          (d * (α.length + x.length + t + 1) ^ d)) ∧
      (¬(F.toFinTM (F.decode α)).ComputesInTime x [true] t →
        S.ComputesInTime (pairEncode (pairEncode (Nat.bits t) α) x) [false]
          (d * (α.length + x.length + t + 1) ^ d)) := by
  obtain ⟨C, entryI, exitI, a, d₀, hk, inst⟩ := us_install F
  obtain ⟨K, Q, hF, hD, U, entry, done, ιP, jctr, jwin, jtbl, jsm, A, B, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6,
      h7, h8, h9, h10, run⟩ :=
    exists_interpreterStartup (fun α => F.numStates (F.decode α))
      (fun α => F.machine (F.decode α)) C entryI exitI
      (fun α => a * ((α.length + 1) ^ d₀ + α.length +
        max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 1)) hk
      (fun x α => by rw [← serializeK_eq]; exact inst x α) F.k
  obtain ⟨g, gw, gP, gt, gs, gc⟩ := us_bank ιP jctr jwin jtbl jsm h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7 h8 h9 h10
  let S : FinTM Bool :=
    { k := K, State := Q ⊕ (CounterLoopState (Σ key, StepBlock.Ph F.k key) × Bool),
      tm := { seamCompTM U done (embedEmitTM g (h1HostedVerdictTM F.k))
        (CounterLoopState.dec FlagPhase.run, true) with q₀ := Sum.inl entry } }
  refine ⟨S, a * ((F.serialize F.fallback).length + 4) +
      A * ((F.serialize F.fallback).length + 3) + 3 * B +
      50 * (F.serialize F.fallback).length + 110 + d₀ + 2, fun α x t => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨T₁, hT₁, hdone, hcut, hin, hout, hctr, hctrp, hwin, hwinp, htbl, htblp, hsm, hsmp,
      hpas⟩ := run α x t (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ _ => rfl)
  obtain ⟨T₂, hT₂, answer, halt, out, hans⟩ :=
    us_run F α x t U entry done g ιP jctr jwin jtbl jsm gw gP gt gs gc _ T₁ rfl hdone hcut hout
      hctr hctrp hwin hwinp htbl htblp hsm hsmp hpas
  have hs : (pairEncode (F.numStates (F.decode α)).bits
      (unaryFin (F.machine (F.decode α)).q₀ ++ tableBitsK (F.machine (F.decode α)).tr)).length ≤
      max α.length (F.serialize F.fallback).length := by
    have h := F.serialize_decode_length_le α
    rw [F.serialize_eq, serializeK_eq] at h
    exact h
  exact us_verdict S _ (T₁ + 1 + T₂) _ answer _
    (us_ledger a d₀ A B (F.serialize F.fallback).length α.length x.length t T₁ T₂ _ _ _ _
      (by omega) hs (us_table_le F α) (length_bits_le_self t) hT₁ hT₂) halt out hans

end MachineFormat

end Turing
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Nondeterministic.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 Seyoon Ragavan. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Finite
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.StateRenaming

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Nondeterministic Multi-Tape Turing Machines

[AB09, §2.1.2]: a nondeterministic Turing machine (NDTM) is a standard TM with **two**
transition functions `δ₀` and `δ₁`; at every step the machine chooses which of the two to
apply. A finite run is therefore governed by a *choice word* — one bit per step — and the
run function is indexed by it. This module defines the raw machine, its choice-word
semantics in the style of the deterministic `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom`, the all-branch
halting predicate that time bounds quantify over, the bundled finite layer `FinNDTM`, and
the embedding of deterministic machines. Acceptance and the class `NTIME` live one layer
up, in `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.NTIME`, because they fix the binary alphabet. The last
section is the run-level layer of the nondeterministic contract variant (C1): runs along
state embeddings, the slice lemma, state relabelling and input locality.

## Design and deviations from [AB09]

* **Two total transition functions, `Bool`-indexed**: the single field
  `tr : Bool → …` carries [AB09]'s `δ₀` as `tr false` and `δ₁` as `tr true`. Both
  functions are total, so no configuration is ever *stuck* — every choice word of every
  length drives a complete run. (This is the load-bearing difference from a
  relational model such as cslib's `MultiTapeNTM`, surveyed and deliberately not
  ported — see the plan's decision log: with binary choice the accepting choice word
  *is* the polynomial-length certificate of [AB09, Theorem 2.6], while arbitrary
  branching relations have no canonical certificate encoding.)
* **Choice words are finite lists** (`List Bool`), consumed left to right, one bit per
  step: `runWith w cfg` is the configuration after `|w|` steps under the choices `w`.
  The alternative — infinite choice streams `ℕ → Bool` with a separate step count — is
  equivalent for every notion built here (only the first `t` bits of a stream are ever
  consulted); the list form makes the choice word a finite string that can be a
  certificate. **Design question (c) for the phase-2 audit.**
* **No `q_accept` state.** [AB09] equips NDTMs with a distinguished accepting state;
  our machines signal through their output tape, exactly as the deterministic
  development does (`Turing.FinTM.DecidesInTime` reads acceptance off the output
  `[true]`/`[false]`). Acceptance-by-output is defined in
  `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.NTIME` and is **design question (a) for the phase-2
  audit**.
* **Halting is absorbing under every choice**: stepping a halted configuration is the
  identity regardless of the choice bit, mirroring the deterministic `step`. Extending
  a choice word beyond the halting time therefore never changes the reached
  configuration — the lemma `runWith_of_halt` below. This is what the exact-length
  quantifiers lean on, *directionally*: accepting witnesses pad to any larger exact
  length, and all-branch halting at a larger budget follows by splitting at the old
  one (`HaltsWithin.mono`). It does **not** make every bounded-length rewriting valid —
  "every word of length at most `t` is halted" already fails at the empty word — and
  the correct bounded readings are recorded in `TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.NTIME`
  (round-1 audit, finding 2).
* The model reuses the vendored configuration layer (`Turing.Cfg`, `Turing.Action`)
  unchanged: an NDTM step applies an `Action` exactly as a deterministic step does; only
  the *selection* of the action is new.

## Main definitions

* `Turing.NDTM` — the binary-choice nondeterministic machine. [AB09, §2.1.2]
* `Turing.NDTM.stepWith`, `Turing.NDTM.runWith` — one step under a choice bit; the run
  under a choice word. [AB09, §2.1.2]
* `Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin` — every choice word of length `t` halts the machine on the
  given input; the totality condition of [AB09]'s "runs in `T(n)` time".
* `Turing.NDTM.fixChoice` — the deterministic slice at a fixed choice bit, with
  `Turing.NDTM.stepWith_eq_fixChoice_step` (added 2026-10-10).
* `Turing.FinNDTM` — the bundled finite layer, mirroring `Turing.FinTM`.
* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.toNDTM`, `Turing.FinTM.toFinNDTM` — a deterministic machine as an
  NDTM whose two transition functions coincide.
* `Turing.NDTM.relabelState` — state relabelling of an NDTM along an equivalence, mirroring
  `Turing.MultiTapeTM.relabelState` (C1).

## Main results

* `Turing.NDTM.runWith_eq_fixChoice_runFrom` — a branch that meets no real choice is the run of
  the deterministic slice (stage 2's slice lemma; statement gated 2026-10-14; proved, by the
  agreement transfer at the identity embedding, C1).
* `Turing.NDTM.runWith_append`, `Turing.NDTM.runWith_of_halt` — the choice-word run
  algebra (proved; pure unfoldings, the nondeterministic counterparts of the vendored
  `runFrom` lemmas).
* `Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin.mono` — all-branch halting is monotone in the time bound.
* `Turing.NDTM.exists_first_halt` — a halted branch halts first at a least prefix of its choice
  word, live before it and already in its final configuration there.
* `Turing.NDTM.not_haltsWithin_zero` — no machine halts within `0` steps along every branch: the
  initial configuration is live (the counterpart of `Turing.FinTM.not_computesInTime_zero`).
* `Turing.MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_runWith` — the embedded deterministic machine ignores its
  choices: every choice word of length `t` reproduces `runFrom` at time `t`.
* `Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn`, `Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn_det` —
  the agreement transfer: a host whose transition functions agree with a nondeterministic or a
  deterministic source along a state embedding, at the states visited, runs as the source
  renamed (with the one-step form `Turing.NDTM.stepWith_mapState_of_agreeOn`; proved, C1).
* `Turing.NDTM.relabelState_runWith` — relabelled branches are the renamed branches (proved).
* `Turing.NDTM.runWith_initCfg_take` — input locality: a branch of at most `m` steps reads only
  the first `m` input symbols (proved, C1).
* The ND inventory API (C1's pre-ship inventory, 2026-10-17): the live step
  `Turing.NDTM.stepWith_of_some`; `Turing.NDTM.initCfg_eq` and `Turing.NDTM.haltsWithin_iff`;
  the fields of the slice `Turing.NDTM.fixChoice_q₀`, `_tr`, of the embedding
  `Turing.MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_q₀`, `_tr` and `Turing.FinTM.toFinNDTM_k`, `_State`, `_tm`, and of
  the relabelling `Turing.NDTM.relabelState_q₀`, `_tr`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§1.2, §1.4; §2.1.2, pp. 41-42.)
* cslib (https://github.com/leanprover/cslib), `MultiTape/Nondeterministic.lean` at
  commit a3747758: a relational nondeterministic model (related work, not ported — see
  `AroraBarakChapter2Plan.md`, decision log).
-/

namespace Turing

variable {k : ℕ} {State Symbol : Type*}

/-- A binary-choice nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine [AB09, §2.1.2]: a
machine with **two** total transition functions, carried as the `Bool`-indexed field
`tr` — `tr false` is [AB09]'s `δ₀` and `tr true` is `δ₁`. Tapes, actions, and
configurations are exactly those of the deterministic `Turing.MultiTapeTM`; as there,
`Symbol` and `State` need not be finite at this layer (the bundled finite layer is
`Turing.FinNDTM` below). -/
structure NDTM (k : ℕ) (Symbol State : Type*) where
  /-- initial state -/
  q₀ : State
  /-- the two transition functions, indexed by the nondeterministic choice: `tr false`
  is `δ₀`, `tr true` is `δ₁`; each maps the state, input symbol, and work-head symbols
  to an action, exactly as the deterministic transition function does -/
  tr (choice : Bool) (q : State) (input : Option Symbol) (work : Fin k → Option Symbol) :
    Action k Symbol State

namespace NDTM

variable {input : List Symbol} {tm : NDTM k Symbol State}

/-- One step under the choice bit `b`: apply the action selected by transition function
`tr b`, or stay put when already halted. Halting is absorbing under **every** choice —
the halted branch does not consult `b` — mirroring `Turing.MultiTapeTM.step`. -/
def stepWith (b : Bool) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) : Cfg k Symbol State input :=
  match cfg.state with
  | none => cfg
  | some q => (tm.tr b q cfg.inputSymbol cfg.workTapeSymbols).apply cfg

/-- The initial configuration corresponding to an input string — identical to the
deterministic initialization (blank work tapes, input head on the first symbol). -/
@[simp]
def initCfg (input : List Symbol) : Cfg k Symbol State input := Cfg.init tm.q₀ input

/-- **The initial configuration is `Cfg.init` at the start state** (the ND inventory API,
2026-10-17), the counterpart of `Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq`:
`tm.initCfg input = Cfg.init tm.q₀ input`. -/
theorem initCfg_eq (input : List Symbol) : tm.initCfg input = Cfg.init tm.q₀ input :=
  rfl

/-- The configuration reached from `cfg` by running under the choice word `w`, one
choice bit per step, consumed left to right: `|w|` steps in total. This is the
nondeterministic counterpart of `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom`; a "branch" of the
computation tree of [AB09, §2.1.2] is the run under one choice word. -/
def runWith : List Bool → Cfg k Symbol State input → Cfg k Symbol State input
  | [], cfg => cfg
  | b :: w, cfg => runWith w (tm.stepWith b cfg)

/-- The empty choice word runs zero steps. -/
@[simp]
lemma runWith_nil {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} : tm.runWith [] cfg = cfg := rfl

/-- Consuming one choice bit is one step: the run under `b :: w` is the run under `w`
from the configuration one `stepWith b` ahead. -/
lemma runWith_cons {b : Bool} {w : List Bool} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} :
    tm.runWith (b :: w) cfg = tm.runWith w (tm.stepWith b cfg) := rfl

/-- Running under `w ++ w'` is running under `w`, then under `w'` from the reached
configuration — the counterpart of `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add`. -/
lemma runWith_append (w w' : List Bool) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) :
    tm.runWith (w ++ w') cfg = tm.runWith w' (tm.runWith w cfg) := by
  induction w generalizing cfg with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih => rw [List.cons_append, runWith_cons, runWith_cons, ih]

/-- The deterministic slice of a nondeterministic machine at a fixed choice bit: the
multi-tape machine that always uses the transition function `tm.tr b`. [AB09, §2.1.2: an
NDTM has two transition functions, and a choice bit selects one] (Shared by the
configuration-graph layer; added 2026-10-10.) -/
def fixChoice (tm : NDTM k Symbol State) (b : Bool) : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State :=
  ⟨tm.q₀, tm.tr b⟩

/-! The slice's fields as equations (the ND inventory API, 2026-10-17), generated by `simps` without
the `simp` attribute: `(tm.fixChoice b).q₀ = tm.q₀` and `(tm.fixChoice b).tr = tm.tr b`. -/
attribute [simps (config := { isSimp := false }) q₀ tr] fixChoice

/-- One nondeterministic step under the choice bit `b` is one step of the slice at `b`.

**Proof sketch.** Both steps fix a halted configuration, and otherwise apply the action
that `tm.tr b` reads from the same configuration (`cases` on the state). -/
theorem stepWith_eq_fixChoice_step (tm : NDTM k Symbol State) (b : Bool)
    (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) : tm.stepWith b cfg = (tm.fixChoice b).step cfg := by
  cases h : cfg.state <;> simp only [NDTM.stepWith, MultiTapeTM.step, fixChoice, h]

/-- Stepping a halted configuration is the identity, under either choice. -/
@[simp]
lemma stepWith_of_halt {b : Bool} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} (h : cfg.state = none) :
    tm.stepWith b cfg = cfg := by
  unfold stepWith
  rw [h]

/-- **A live step applies the chosen action** (the ND inventory API, 2026-10-17), the counterpart of
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.step_of_some`: at a live state `q` one step under the choice bit `b` applies the
action of `tm.tr b` for the scanned symbols, `cfg.state = some q →`
`tm.stepWith b cfg = (tm.tr b q cfg.inputSymbol cfg.workTapeSymbols).apply cfg`. -/
theorem stepWith_of_some {b : Bool} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} {q : State}
    (h : cfg.state = some q) :
    tm.stepWith b cfg = (tm.tr b q cfg.inputSymbol cfg.workTapeSymbols).apply cfg := by
  unfold stepWith
  rw [h]

/-- Running from a halted configuration stays there, under **every** choice word — the
counterpart of `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_of_halt`. Extending a choice word beyond the
halting time therefore never changes the reached configuration. -/
@[simp]
lemma runWith_of_halt (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) (h : cfg.state = none)
    {w : List Bool} : tm.runWith w cfg = cfg := by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih => rw [runWith_cons, stepWith_of_halt h]; exact ih

/-- The machine halts on `input` within `t` steps **along every branch**: after any `t`
nondeterministic choices the configuration is halted. This is the totality condition in
[AB09]'s "runs in `T(n)` time" (§2.1.2: *every* sequence of choices reaches the halting
state within the bound), rendered over choice words of length exactly `t`; by
`Turing.NDTM.runWith_of_halt` the exact-length quantifier already covers all longer
words, and `Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin.mono` makes this precise. -/
def HaltsWithin (tm : NDTM k Symbol State) (input : List Symbol) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = t → (tm.runWith w (tm.initCfg input)).state = none

/-- **All-branch halting, unfolded** (the ND inventory API, 2026-10-17): `tm.HaltsWithin input t`
holds iff every choice word `w` of length `t` leaves the run from `tm.initCfg input` halted,
`∀ w, w.length = t → (tm.runWith w (tm.initCfg input)).state = none`. -/
theorem haltsWithin_iff {tm : NDTM k Symbol State} {input : List Symbol} {t : ℕ} :
    tm.HaltsWithin input t ↔
      ∀ w : List Bool, w.length = t → (tm.runWith w (tm.initCfg input)).state = none :=
  Iff.rfl

/-- All-branch halting is monotone in the time bound.

**Proof sketch.** Given `w` with `|w| = t' ≥ t`, split `w = w.take t ++ w.drop t`
(`List.take_append_drop`) with `|w.take t| = t` (`List.length_take`, since `t ≤ t'`).
By the hypothesis the run under `w.take t` is halted; `Turing.NDTM.runWith_append`
factors the run under `w` through it, and `Turing.NDTM.runWith_of_halt` absorbs the
remaining choices, so the state at `w` equals the halted state at `w.take t`. -/
theorem HaltsWithin.mono {tm : NDTM k Symbol State} {input : List Symbol} {t t' : ℕ}
    (h : tm.HaltsWithin input t) (hle : t ≤ t') : tm.HaltsWithin input t' := by
  intro w hw
  have hlen : (w.take t).length = t := List.length_take_of_le (hle.trans_eq hw.symm)
  have hhalt := h (w.take t) hlen
  have hrun := runWith_append (tm := tm) (w.take t) (w.drop t) (tm.initCfg input)
  rw [List.take_append_drop, runWith_of_halt _ hhalt] at hrun
  rw [hrun]
  exact hhalt

/-- **No branch halts in zero steps**: on every input, a machine
does not halt within `0` steps along every branch, `¬ tm.HaltsWithin input 0`, because the empty
choice word leaves the run at the initial configuration, whose state `some tm.q₀` is live. In
particular an all-branch time budget of `0` (e.g. from a vanishing time bound) is never met. This
is the nondeterministic counterpart of `Turing.FinTM.not_computesInTime_zero`.

**Proof sketch.** Apply all-branch halting at budget `0` to the empty choice word: the run under
it is the initial configuration (`Turing.NDTM.runWith_nil`), which is `Cfg.init` at the start
state (`Turing.NDTM.initCfg_eq`) and so has state `some tm.q₀` (`Turing.Cfg.init_state`), not
`none`. -/
theorem not_haltsWithin_zero (tm : NDTM k Symbol State) (input : List Symbol) :
    ¬ tm.HaltsWithin input 0 := by
  intro h
  have h0 := haltsWithin_iff.mp h [] rfl
  rw [runWith_nil, initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state] at h0
  exact Option.some_ne_none _ h0

/-- **First halt along a choice word**: if the run from `cfg` along the choice word `w` has
halted, there is a least prefix length `u ≤ |w|` at which it has halted: the run along
`w.take u` is halted, the run along every shorter prefix is live, and the run along `w` is the
run along `w.take u`, halting being absorbing under every choice [AB09, §2.1.2]. The
nondeterministic counterpart of `Turing.MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt`.

**Proof sketch.** Take `u` least with a halted run along `w.take u` (`Nat.find`; `u = |w|`
qualifies, `List.take_length`). Minimality gives liveness below `u`. Splitting
`w = w.take u ++ w.drop u`, `Turing.NDTM.runWith_append` and `Turing.NDTM.runWith_of_halt`
identify the run along `w` with the run along `w.take u`. -/
theorem exists_first_halt (tm : NDTM k Symbol State) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input)
    {w : List Bool} (h : (tm.runWith w cfg).state = none) :
    ∃ u ≤ w.length, (tm.runWith (w.take u) cfg).state = none ∧
      (∀ v < u, (tm.runWith (w.take v) cfg).state ≠ none) ∧
      tm.runWith w cfg = tm.runWith (w.take u) cfg := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ u, (tm.runWith (w.take u) cfg).state = none :=
    ⟨w.length, by rw [List.take_length]; exact h⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.find hex, Nat.find_min' hex (by rw [List.take_length]; exact h),
    Nat.find_spec hex, fun v hv => Nat.find_min hex hv, ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop (Nat.find hex) w]
  rw [runWith_append, runWith_of_halt _ (Nat.find_spec hex)]

end NDTM

/-- A nondeterministic machine bundled with a finite state type, mirroring
`Turing.FinTM`: the instances are data (`Fintype`/`DecidableEq`, not `Finite`) for the
same reason as there — a machine that is to be encoded as a string must enumerate its
transition tables. All headline nondeterministic-complexity definitions
(`Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInTime`, `Complexity.NTIME`) are stated over this layer. -/
structure FinNDTM (Symbol : Type) : Type 1 where
  /-- number of work tapes -/
  k : ℕ
  /-- the state type -/
  State : Type
  /-- the state type is finite, as data -/
  [fintypeState : Fintype State]
  /-- states are decidably discernible -/
  [decEqState : DecidableEq State]
  /-- the underlying nondeterministic machine -/
  tm : NDTM k Symbol State

attribute [instance] FinNDTM.fintypeState FinNDTM.decEqState

/-- A deterministic machine as a nondeterministic one whose two transition functions
coincide: both choices apply the deterministic transition. This is the embedding behind
`DTIME ⊆ NTIME` ([AB09, §2.1.2]: a TM is an NDTM that ignores its choices). -/
def MultiTapeTM.toNDTM (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) : NDTM k Symbol State :=
  ⟨tm.q₀, fun _ => tm.tr⟩

/-! The embedding's fields as equations (the ND inventory API, 2026-10-17), by `simps` without the
`simp` attribute: `tm.toNDTM.q₀ = tm.q₀` and `tm.toNDTM.tr b = tm.tr` for either choice. -/
attribute [simps (config := { isSimp := false }) q₀ tr] MultiTapeTM.toNDTM

/-- The embedded deterministic machine starts where the original does. -/
@[simp]
lemma MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_initCfg (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) (input : List Symbol) :
    tm.toNDTM.initCfg input = tm.initCfg input := rfl

/-- The embedded deterministic machine ignores its choices: running `toNDTM` under any
choice word `w` is running the original machine for `|w|` steps.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `w` generalizing the configuration. For one step,
`Turing.NDTM.stepWith` on `toNDTM` and `Turing.MultiTapeTM.step` are the same match on
the state — halted branches are both the identity, and on a live state both apply the
action `tm.tr q …` since `toNDTM.tr b = tm.tr` for either `b`. The cons case is then
`Turing.NDTM.runWith_cons` against `Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step` (the step
count on the right is `|w| + 1`, `List.length_cons`). -/
theorem MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_runWith (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State) {input : List Symbol}
    (w : List Bool) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input) :
    tm.toNDTM.runWith w cfg = tm.runFrom cfg w.length := by
  induction w generalizing cfg with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, List.length_cons, runFrom_succ_eq_step]
    exact ih (tm.step cfg)

/-- A bundled deterministic machine as a bundled nondeterministic one — the `FinTM`
layer of `Turing.MultiTapeTM.toNDTM`, with the same tapes and state type. -/
def FinTM.toFinNDTM {Symbol : Type} (M : FinTM Symbol) : FinNDTM Symbol :=
  ⟨M.k, M.State, M.tm.toNDTM⟩

/-! The bundled embedding's fields as equations (the ND inventory API, 2026-10-17), by `simps`
without the `simp` attribute: `M.toFinNDTM.k = M.k`, `M.toFinNDTM.State = M.State` and
`M.toFinNDTM.tm = M.tm.toNDTM`. -/
attribute [simps (config := { isSimp := false }) k State tm] FinTM.toFinNDTM

end Turing

/-! ## Branches along state embeddings, deterministic slices, relabelling, input locality

The run-level layer of the nondeterministic contract variant (design §15d and §16; the C1 design
note §3.1). A deterministic host whose correctness is a per-step lockstep lifts to NDTMs slice by
slice: `Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn` transfers a run along a state embedding when the
host's two transition functions agree with the source's on the states visited, and its
deterministic-source form `Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn_det` carries every
deterministic phase contract to every branch. `Turing.NDTM.runWith_eq_fixChoice_runFrom` is the
slice lemma that stage 2's nondeterministic form needs (statement gated by the stage-2 pack,
`audits/stage2-statements-pack.md`; proof here). `Turing.NDTM.relabelState` mirrors
`Turing.MultiTapeTM.relabelState`. `Turing.NDTM.runWith_initCfg_take` is input locality: a
branch of at most `m` steps reads only the first `m` input symbols. -/

namespace Turing.NDTM

section Transfer

variable {k : ℕ} {Γ S H : Type*}

/-- **One step transfers along a state embedding.** Suppose that at every good state both
transition functions of `host` are the transition functions of `src` with successors renamed
along `emb`. Then from a configuration that is halted or at a good state, one step of `host`
under either choice bit is the renamed step of `src` under that bit. (Technical glue, no
textbook counterpart: the one-step identity behind `Turing.NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn`.)

**Proof sketch.** A halted configuration is fixed by both steps. At a good state both steps read
the same symbols, the agreement selects the renamed action, and renaming commutes with applying
an action (`Turing.Cfg.mapState_apply`). -/
theorem stepWith_mapState_of_agreeOn {x : List Γ}
    (src : NDTM k Γ S) (host : NDTM k Γ H) (emb : S ↪ H) (good : S → Prop)
    (hagree : ∀ (b : Bool) (q : S), good q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr b (emb q) inp work = (src.tr b q inp work).mapState emb)
    (c : Cfg k Γ S x) (hc : ∀ q, c.state = some q → good q) (b : Bool) :
    host.stepWith b (c.mapState emb) = (src.stepWith b c).mapState emb := by
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none =>
    have h1 : (c.mapState emb).state = none := by simp [Cfg.mapState, hs]
    rw [stepWith_of_halt h1, stepWith_of_halt hs]
  | some q =>
    have h1 : (c.mapState emb).state = some (emb q) := by simp [Cfg.mapState, hs]
    unfold stepWith
    rw [h1, hs]
    simp only
    rw [hagree b q (hc q hs)]
    exact Cfg.mapState_apply emb _ c

/-- **The nondeterministic agreement transfer** (the run-level nondeterministic contract
variant of design §15d and §16). Suppose that both transition functions of `host` agree, along
the state embedding `emb`, with the corresponding transition functions of `src` at every good
state, and that the run of `src` under the choice word `w` is at a good state whenever it is
live before its end. Then `host` under `w` runs exactly as `src` under `w`, renamed. The
endpoint is unrestricted, and `w = []` is the trivial case. [AB09, §2.1.2: a branch is the run
along one choice word]

**Proof sketch.** Induct on `w`. The guard at time `0` licenses the one-step identity
(`Turing.NDTM.stepWith_mapState_of_agreeOn`), and the shifted guard feeds the induction
hypothesis. -/
theorem runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn {x : List Γ}
    (src : NDTM k Γ S) (host : NDTM k Γ H) (emb : S ↪ H) (good : S → Prop)
    (hagree : ∀ (b : Bool) (q : S), good q → ∀ inp work,
      host.tr b (emb q) inp work = (src.tr b q inp work).mapState emb)
    (c : Cfg k Γ S x) (w : List Bool)
    (hguard : ∀ u < w.length, ∀ q, (src.runWith (w.take u) c).state = some q → good q) :
    host.runWith w (c.mapState emb) = (src.runWith w c).mapState emb := by
  induction w generalizing c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b w ih =>
    have h0 : ∀ q, c.state = some q → good q := fun q hq =>
      hguard 0 (by simp) q (by simpa using hq)
    rw [runWith_cons, runWith_cons,
      stepWith_mapState_of_agreeOn src host emb good hagree c h0 b]
    apply ih
    intro u hu q hq
    exact hguard (u + 1) (by simp; omega) q
      (by simpa [List.take_succ_cons, runWith_cons] using hq)

/-- **The transfer from a deterministic source.** Suppose that both transition functions of
